Le Brent prend 1,33% à 114,67 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) gagne 1,62% à 101,08 dollars. Le gain mensuel du Brent dépasse les 10%, tandis que les prix du gaz naturel en Europe progressent de près de 30% depuis début octobre. item.title: Bristol Myers, SystImmune breast cancer drug cuts progression risk in study
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb and partner SystImmune said on Friday their experimental breast cancer treatment slowed disease progression compared to standard chemotherapy in a late-stage study.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) and partner SystImmune said on Friday their experimental breast cancer treatment slowed disease progression compared to standard chemotherapy in a late-stage study. The drug, izalontamab brengitecan, reduced the risk of disease worsening or death by 59% in patients with advanced hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer — the most common form of breast cancer — who had failed at least one prior line of chemotherapy. Izalontamab brengitecan belongs to a class of treatments known as antibody-drug conjugates, often called "guided missiles". It targets two specific proteins, EGFR and HER3, to deliver a cancer-killing payload directly to tumor cells. In the study, which enrolled 383 patients, those treated with the drug lived for a median of 8.2 months without their cancer growing, compared to four months for the participants on standard chemotherapy. About 40.5% of patients on iza-bren saw their tumors shrink, compared to 20.2% on chemotherapy. The response lasted a median of 6.9 months, versus 4.2 months for chemotherapy. Data on overall survival, how long patients lived in total, was not yet mature at the time of the interim analysis. The full results will be presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology congress in Madrid. Bristol Myers had partnered with SystImmune, a unit of Chinese drugmaker Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical, in an [USN:L4N3D63QM TEXT:"up to $8.4 billion"] deal announced in 2023 to develop and commercialize the drug outside mainland China. Its side effects were manageable and no new safety concerns emerged, Bristol Myers said. Only 1.6% of patients stopped treatment because of side effects, while two patients developed mild-to-moderate lung inflammation.

item.title: Russian ESPO oil sellers seek record premiums as Gulf exports uncertain
item.description: Russian oil sellers have raised ESPO Blend offers to China to record levels, supported by strong demand and higher freight costs driven by the Iran war, although some independent Chinese refiners may baulk as margins turn negative, traders said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian oil sellers have raised ESPO Blend offers to China to record levels, supported by strong demand and higher freight costs driven by the Iran war, although some independent Chinese refiners may baulk as margins turn negative, traders said. Far East ESPO Blend cargoes for end-December and January delivery have been offered at premiums above $25 a barrel to ICE Brent, with two offers heard above $30 a barrel delivered to China, traders said. November and December cargoes were offered at premiums of $26-$27 a barrel, with a few remaining unsold, another trader said. Some market participants said sellers were testing buyers' appetite with the hefty offers amid disruptions to Middle East exports. US President Donald Trump's announcement last Friday of a [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"waiver"] on key sanctions against Russia also supported demand expectations, although details remain unclear, two traders said. Russian oil has become more expensive for Asian buyers because it is priced against Brent, while most Middle East grades are linked to Dubai. Brent typically trades at a premium to Dubai, and that gap has widened. The Brent-Dubai spread settled at $5.05 a barrel on Thursday. Oil prices [USN:L1N46903W TEXT:"rose"] on Friday, with Brent crude touching a more than five-month high of nearly $115 a barrel, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East. Two traders said Chinese refiners were still willing to pay premiums of $20 a barrel for ESPO Blend, but not the latest record high offer levels. However, one recent deal by a large independent Chinese refiner for November and December cargoes was heard at premiums of $23-$26 a barrel to ICE Brent, a senior Chinese trader said, adding that smaller plants would lose money at those levels. That compared with $12 premiums for November shipments [USN:L1N4520CP TEXT:"Reuters reported in September"]. ELEVATED FREIGHT RATES Russian sellers say elevated freight rates have driven up ESPO prices and should be reflected in premiums. Aframax tanker rates from Kozmino to China briefly surged to $10 million per voyage in October before falling to about $2 million, a decline that could eventually pressure ESPO premiums lower, traders said. Russian Urals oil prices recently [USN:L6N46014O TEXT:"weakened"] to parity with dated Brent and small discounts to the benchmark in some cases as top Asian clients - Indian refiners - were not able to pay such high prices and turned to alternatives.

item.title: France Tirs dans les Yvelines, un mort et quatre blessés, le Pnat saisi
item.description: Un homme à bord d'un véhicule a tiré à l'arme automatique sur la voie publique vendredi à Trappes et La Verrière, deux communes des Yvelines, à l'ouest de Paris, faisant un mort et quatre blessés graves, avant d'être interpellé, a déclaré le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, qui va se rendre sur place.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un homme à bord d'un véhicule a tiré à l'arme automatique sur la voie publique vendredi à Trappes et La Verrière, deux communes des Yvelines, à l'ouest de Paris, faisant un mort et quatre blessés graves, avant d'être interpellé, a déclaré le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, qui va se rendre sur place. Le Parquet national antiterroriste a annoncé s'être saisi des faits "qui ont été commis à raison de l'appartenance vraie ou supposée, à une prétendue race, une ethnie, une nation ou une religion déterminée". Le Pnat a ouvert une enquête de flagrance des chefs d'assassinat et de tentatives d'assassinat en relation avec une entreprise terroriste, de détention d'arme de catégorie A [armes de guerre] et d'association de malfaiteurs terroriste en vue de la préparation de crimes contre les personnes. Aucune information n'a été communiquée pour l'heure par les autorités sur les motivations du tireur. "Le tireur manifestement tirait au hasard et avait envie de faire un carnage", a déclaré le maire de Trappes, Ali Rabeh, sur BFM TV, évoquant des "tirs nourris" dans plusieurs quartiers de la ville, visant notamment un espace de jeux et une maison de santé ainsi que plusieurs véhicules. "C'est un miracle qu'on n'ait pas davantage de victimes", a-t-il ajouté.

item.title: Auge de GLP-1 en China, India y Brasil podría crear mercado de 22.000 millones de dólares para 2035: J.P. Morgan
item.description: El mercado conjunto de China, India y Brasil de medicamentos para adelgazar podría crecer hasta alcanzar los 22.000 millones de dólares en 2035, frente a los 6.600 millones actuales, según estimaciones de J.P. Morgan, ya que la mejora de la asequibilidad y un mayor acceso impulsan su adopción en poblaciones de pacientes en gran medida sin explotar.
item.dc:creator: Joel Jose
item.content:encoded: El mercado conjunto de China, India y Brasil de medicamentos para adelgazar podría crecer hasta alcanzar los 22.000 millones de dólares en 2035, frente a los 6.600 millones actuales, según estimaciones de J.P. Morgan, ya que la mejora de la asequibilidad y un mayor acceso impulsan su adopción en poblaciones de pacientes en gran medida sin explotar. El mercado potencial podría crecer a una tasa anual del 15% hasta 2035, afirmaron el viernes en una nota los analistas de J.P. Morgan, liderados por Yang Huang, dada la elevada incidencia de la diabetes y la obesidad en estos países. Los medicamentos de GLP-1, como Ozempic y Wegovy, de Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) , y Zepbound, de Eli Lilly (LLY.N) , se han convertido en algunos de los fármacos más demandados a nivel mundial para la pérdida de peso y el tratamiento de la diabetes. China y la India albergan algunas de las mayores poblaciones de pacientes con diabetes del mundo, representando más del 25% y el 15% de los casos diagnosticados a nivel mundial, respectivamente, mientras que alrededor del 12% de los adultos brasileños padecen diabetes, según J.P. Morgan. Los tres países también se enfrentan a una creciente carga de obesidad. La población con sobrepeso y obesidad en China podría superar el 65% para 2030, mientras que se prevé que la tasa de obesidad en adultos de la India alcance el 11% para 2035. "El GLP-1 está pasando de ser un tema de crecimiento en los mercados desarrollados a convertirse en una cuestión de acceso global más amplia...", afirmaron los analistas. "Con la expiración de las patentes, el lanzamiento de genéricos y los recortes de precios impulsados por las políticas, que ahora mejoran la asequibilidad del GLP-1, los tres mercados convergen hacia el mismo destino". MERCADOS INEXPLORADOS La aceptación del GLP-1 en muchos mercados emergentes se ha mantenido baja debido a las preocupaciones sobre su asequibilidad. La penetración es inferior al 0,1% en China y al 0,2% en la India, frente al 4%-5% en Estados Unidos, según la nota. Aunque Brasil es actualmente el mayor de los tres mercados, se prevé que la penetración de los medicamentos contra la obesidad alcance solo entre el 7% y el 8% de su población obesa para 2035, en comparación con alrededor del 30% en Estados Unidos. J.P. Morgan prevé que China supere a Brasil para 2027, con un mercado que alcanzará los 13.700 millones de dólares en 2035, frente a los 8.000 millones de Brasil, gracias a su elevada carga de diabetes y a una mayor cobertura de las terapias con GLP-1. En cuanto a la India, el más pequeño de los tres mercados, las actitudes conservadoras hacia los fármacos de GLP-1, junto con las preocupaciones sobre su asequibilidad, siguen siendo obstáculos clave para su adopción, según J.P. Morgan, ya que persisten las reticencias hacia los inyectables y las actitudes culturales que cambian lentamente. La agencia de valores destacó a la china Innovent (1801.HK) , a Divi’s Laboratories (DIVI.NS) y a Torrent Pharmaceuticals (TORP.NS) en la India, así como a la brasileña RD Saúde (RADL3.SA) , como sus valores clave para aprovechar la tendencia de crecimiento del GLP-1.

item.title: Aviones de combate británicos participan por primera vez en maniobras nucleares francesas
item.description: Aviones británicos y franceses sobrevolaron juntos el Mediterráneo en su primer ejercicio conjunto en el que participó la capacidad nuclear aérea de Francia, según informó París este viernes, lo que pone de relieve su cooperación en un momento de tensiones con Rusia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aviones británicos y franceses sobrevolaron juntos el Mediterráneo en su primer ejercicio conjunto en el que participó la capacidad nuclear aérea de Francia, según informó París este viernes, lo que pone de relieve su cooperación en un momento de tensiones con Rusia. Los dos aliados acordaron en julio de 2025 reforzar la cooperación en torno a sus arsenales nucleares como respuesta a las crecientes amenazas que se ciernen sobre Europa y a la incertidumbre respecto a su aliado estadounidense. "Disponer de fuerzas nucleares independientes no impide la coordinación", afirmó la ministra de las Fuerzas Armadas francesas, Catherine Vautrin. "Nuestra cooperación nuclear con el Reino Unido sigue profundizándose: el martes por la noche, los Typhoon británicos participaron por primera vez en un ejercicio nuclear francés junto a los (aviones de combate) Rafale". Tras despegar de la base aérea de Saint-Dizier, en el noreste de Francia, los aviones franceses fueron escoltados por cazas Typhoon de la RAF británica, simulando un ataque nuclear en un ejercicio denominado "Rummy", según informó el Ministerio de las Fuerzas Armadas de Francia. "En un mundo cada vez más peligroso, nuestros adversarios no deben tener ninguna duda: Reino Unido y Francia están unidos en su compromiso con la seguridad europea y con el mantenimiento de la disuasión que ha ayudado a preservar la paz durante generaciones", añadió el secretario de Defensa británico, Wes Streeting. El presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, declaró en marzo que París ampliará su arsenal nuclear y puso en marcha una iniciativa para ofrecer a los socios europeos ejercicios conjuntos y un posible despliegue a corto plazo de medios franceses con capacidad nuclear en su territorio. Francia gasta unos 5.600 millones de euros (6.040 millones de dólares) al año para mantener su arsenal de 290 armas para lanzarse desde submarinos y aviones, el cuarto mayor del mundo. Reino Unido cuenta con 225 ojivas nucleares. En comparación, Rusia y Estados Unidos tienen más de 5.000 cada uno.

item.title: India stays net finished steel importer in April-September, government data shows
item.description: India remained a net importer of finished steel in the first half of the fiscal year as imports grew faster than domestic production, government data showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India remained a net importer of finished steel in the first half of the fiscal year as imports grew faster than domestic production, government data showed on Friday. Here are more details: Finished steel imports jumped 23.8% from a year earlier to 4.14 million metric tons during April-September, exceeding exports of 3.55 million tons China and South Korea together accounted for nearly 63% of imports, while the United Arab Emirates and Vietnam were India's largest export destinations Finished steel consumption increased 7.7% year-on-year in September to 14.4 million tons Steel prices rose from a year earlier in October, with hot-rolled coil up 31.6% and cold-rolled coil gaining 33.3%

item.title: Inflação subjacente do Japão ultrapassa meta e reforça possibilidade de aumento dos juros no curto prazo
item.description: A inflação básica ao consumidor do Japão ultrapassou a meta de 2% do banco central em setembro pela primeira vez em nove meses, segundo dados divulgados nesta sexta-feira, um sinal de que a pressão sobre os preços está se ampliando, o que reforça os argumentos a favor de um aumento das taxas de juros no curto prazo.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara, Takahiko Wada
item.content:encoded: A inflação básica ao consumidor do Japão ultrapassou a meta de 2% do banco central em setembro pela primeira vez em nove meses, segundo dados divulgados nesta sexta-feira, um sinal de que a pressão sobre os preços está se ampliando, o que reforça os argumentos a favor de um aumento das taxas de juros no curto prazo. Os números destacaram como os custos mais elevados dos combustíveis, decorrentes do prolongado conflito no Oriente Médio, os preços elevados das importações impulsionados pelo iene fraco e as pressões sobre os preços decorrentes da forte demanda por inteligência artificial estavam atenuando o impacto dos subsídios governamentais aos combustíveis. Tendo acabado de aumentar as taxas de juros no mês passado, o Banco do Japão deve manter sua política inalterada na próxima semana, mas pode revisar para cima sua previsão de inflação e sinalizar que está pronto para continuar elevando os custos de empréstimos, que ainda estão baixos, segundo fontes ouvidas pela Reuters. “Espera-se que a inflação subjacente acelere devido ao aumento dos custos de energia decorrentes do conflito no Oriente Médio e aos efeitos de segunda ordem decorrentes disso”, disse Masato Koike, economista sênior do Sompo Institute Plus. “Mas, como os aumentos de preços não estão se acelerando de forma acentuada, há pouca necessidade de um novo aumento consecutivo dos juros em outubro”, disse ele, projetando que o próximo aumento dos juros pelo Banco do Japão ocorra em dezembro. O índice de preços ao consumidor básico, que exclui alimentos frescos — cujos preços são voláteis —, mas inclui os custos dos combustíveis, subiu 2,1% em setembro em relação ao mesmo mês do ano anterior, segundo os dados, em linha com a previsão mediana do mercado e acelerando em relação ao aumento de 1,7% registrado em agosto. Um índice que exclui os efeitos tanto dos alimentos frescos, que apresentam alta volatilidade, quanto dos combustíveis — e que é acompanhado de perto pelo Banco do Japão como um indicador mais preciso das pressões inflacionárias impulsionadas pela demanda — subiu 2,4% em setembro em relação ao ano anterior, após um aumento de 1,9% em agosto. Em um sinal de ampliação da pressão inflacionária, os preços dos bens subiram 2,8% em relação ao mesmo mês do ano anterior em setembro, acelerando em relação ao aumento de 2,6% registrado em agosto, segundo os dados. A inflação dos serviços também acelerou para 1,5% em setembro, ante 1,2% no mês anterior, sugerindo que as empresas estavam repassando os custos mais altos com mão de obra decorrentes de um mercado de trabalho restrito. (Reportagem de Leika Kihara e Takahiko Wada)

item.title: A la espera del regreso de Machado, la oposición venezolana pone la mirada en las elecciones
item.description: El movimiento opositor venezolano encabezado por María Corina Machado, galardonada con el premio Nobel de la Paz, se prepara para unas eventuales elecciones, lo que incluye una nueva iniciativa para impulsar el registro de votantes, según documentos y fuentes conocedoras del asunto.
item.dc:creator: Vivian Sequera
item.content:encoded: El movimiento opositor venezolano encabezado por María Corina Machado, galardonada con el premio Nobel de la Paz, se prepara para unas eventuales elecciones, lo que incluye una nueva iniciativa para impulsar el registro de votantes, según documentos y fuentes conocedoras del asunto. El movimiento Vente Venezuela liderado por Machado tiene previsto lanzar una aplicación para recopilar información de los venezolanos que están en el extranjero, de acuerdo con dos fuentes y un documento al que tuvo acceso Reuters. El grupo espera que la aplicación, desarrollada por un equipo de unas 15 personas a lo largo de los últimos 18 meses, pueda facilitar los datos al consejo electoral, permitiendo que nuevos usuarios sean incorporados oficialmente al padrón electoral. Aunque aún no se ha fijado una fecha para los comicios, Machado ha señalado que deberían celebrarse antes de julio de 2027. La líder opositora lleva casi un año fuera del país y, a pesar de las intensas especulaciones sobre un posible regreso inminente, aún no ha anunciado cuándo volverá. Según informó Reuters, es posible que las elecciones no se celebren hasta dentro de un año o más, una vez que se hayan reformado el Tribunal Supremo de Justicia y las autoridades electorales para garantizar condiciones justas. La presidenta encargada, Delcy Rodríguez, ha prometido una transición hacia una "democracia plena" y ha iniciado conversaciones con una facción opositora no vinculada a Machado. Rodríguez asumió el poder en enero después de que la administración del presidente Donald Trump detuviera en Caracas a su predecesor, Nicolás Maduro, quien actualmente está en Nueva York a la espera de juicio por cargos relacionados con narcotráfico y tortura. La oposición sostiene que Edmundo González, representante de Machado, obtuvo una victoria decisiva en las elecciones presidenciales de 2024, si bien las autoridades proclamaron la victoria de Maduro. En esos comicios, la mayoría de los venezolanos que residen en el exterior no pudo votar debido a obstáculos burocráticos para el registro, entre otros problemas. Venezuela, con una población de unos 28,7 millones de habitantes, experimentó una migración masiva durante la década previa a esas elecciones, a causa del colapso económico y la inestabilidad política. Los analistas señalaron que es probable que muchos venezolanos en el extranjero hubieran votado en contra de Maduro, lo que los convierte en un grupo atractivo para la oposición. VENEZOLANOS QUE CRECIERON EN EL EXTRANJERO La aplicación de Vente Venezuela podría ayudar a unos 4 millones de venezolanos en el extranjero a registrarse para votar, según una fuente que no estaba autorizada para hablar públicamente antes de su lanzamiento. El énfasis está en los jóvenes venezolanos que crecieron fuera del país, dentro de una diáspora compuesta por unos 8 millones de personas. El jueves, Vente organizó manifestaciones a nivel nacional —las más grandes en casi dos años—, en las que los participantes exigieron una fecha para las elecciones. Algunos expresaron su frustración ante lo que perciben como un cambio demasiado lento. "Vine a pedir que regrese Maria Corina Machado porque yo no creo en más nadie, ni en nada de lo que este gobierno esta haciendo", dijo Senovia Urdaneta, una pensionada de 60 años, que vende refrescos en su casa en la ciudad petrolera de Maracaibo. Agregó que ni creía "sinceramente ni en Trump, que lo único que tenemos que agradecerle es que se llevara a Maduro, pero seguimos igual". "Soy una vieja a la que cada día se le acorta más la vida con tanto apagón, hambre y desesperanza que sufro. Solo quiero ver a mi nieto regresar, abrazarlo y ahí sí morirme en paz", dijo. Otros depositaron su confianza en los cambios impulsados desde Washington. Desde que el ejército estadounidense capturó a Maduro en enero, Trump y su administración han declarado que Estados Unidos está "al mando" en Venezuela y supervisando su transición. En agosto, Trump anunció un acuerdo que otorga a Estados Unidos el control mayoritario sobre más de 65.000 millones de barriles de reservas de petróleo venezolano. "Quiero que venga María Corina pero todo es estrategia, Estados Unidos esta desmontando el régimen desde la raíz", dijo Omar Brito, de 53 años, de la pequeña ciudad de Charallave, en las afueras de Caracas. Brito, que asegura que hace años dejó de apoyar al partido gobernante, se gana la vida vendiendo pan y mediante remesas enviadas por familiares en el exterior. "Mejor ser estado 51 (de Estados Unidos) que estar subyugados a este régimen".

item.title: British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says
item.description: Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says

Britain and France agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.

PARIS: British and French jets flew together over the Mediterranean in their first joint exercise involving France's airborne nuclear capability, Paris said on Friday (Oct 23), underscoring their cooperation at a time of friction with Russia. The two allies agreed in July 2025 to reinforce cooperation over their nuclear arsenals in response to growing threats to Europe and uncertainty over their US ally.   "Having independent nuclear forces does not preclude coordination," said French Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin. "Our nuclear cooperation with the United Kingdom continues to deepen: on Tuesday evening, British Typhoons took part for the very first time in a French nuclear exercise alongside Rafales (warplanes)."

After taking off from the Saint-Dizier air base in northeastern France, the French jets were escorted by British RAF Typhoon fighters, simulating a nuclear strike in an exercise called "Rummy", France's Armed Forces ministry said. "In an increasingly dangerous world, our adversaries should be in no doubt: the United Kingdom and France stand together in their commitment to European security and to maintaining the deterrence that has helped preserve peace for generations," added British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting. France's President Emmanuel Macron said in March that Paris would expand its nuclear arsenal and launched an initiative offering European partners joint exercises and possible short-term deployment of French nuclear-capable assets on their territory.  France spends roughly €5.6 billion (US$6.04 billion) a year to maintain its stockpile of 290 submarine- and air-launched weapons — the world's fourth-largest arsenal.  Britain has 225 nuclear warheads.  In comparison, Russia and the United States have more than 5,000 each.

item.title: Kodal plans West Africa lithium expansion, CEO says
item.description: Kodal Minerals aims to build a broader West African lithium portfolio beyond its Bougouni mine in Mali, drawing on nearly two decades of operating experience in the region, Chief Executive Bernard Aylward said.
item.dc:creator: Maxwell Adombila
item.content:encoded: Kodal Minerals (KOD.L) aims to build a broader West African lithium portfolio beyond its Bougouni mine in Mali, drawing on nearly two decades of operating experience in the region, Chief Executive Bernard Aylward said. The London-listed miner's Bougouni lithium mine, a joint venture with China's Hainan (601969.SS) , entered production last year . Kodal also has gold exploration assets in Mali and Ivory Coast and this week agreed to earn up to an 80% stake in Ghana's Asamankese lithium project, extending its regional presence. WEST AFRICA DIVERSIFIES INTO CRITICAL MINERALS West Africa, one of the world's leading gold-producing regions, is increasingly targeting investment in critical minerals such as lithium as governments seek to diversify their mining sectors and increase returns from mining, [USN:L8N3ZX0RE TEXT:"sometimes rattling investors"]. Aylward told Reuters this week that West Africa remains an attractive mining destination and the company was deliberately focusing on the region where it had built expertise over the past 15 to 18 years. "We understand the legislation, we understand how to work with local communities and authorities, and we believe the geological potential is very strong," he said. The company believes the Asamankese project could emerge as a significant discovery after early exploration results showed similarities to the initial stages of development at Bougouni. Kodal plans to fund exploration from existing cash resources and mine cash flow rather than raising fresh equity, Aylward said. Recovering lithium prices have improved the outlook for new mine development after a downturn that slowed projects across the sector, including Ghana's flagship Ewoyaa project . Aylward said growing demand from electric vehicles, energy storage and consumer electronics continued to support a strong long-term outlook for lithium and new supply investments. "We believe ....that new supply brought to market will be rewarded," he said.

item.title: SLB tops estimates on resilient North America demand, sees Middle East rebound
item.description: SLB beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Friday, supported by strong North American oilfield activity, while signaling recovery in parts of the Middle East following conflict-related disruptions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SLB (SLB.N) beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Friday, supported by strong North American oilfield activity, while signaling recovery in parts of the Middle East following conflict-related disruptions. Repeated flare-ups in the US-Iran conflict , now in its eighth month, have pressured oilfield services companies with significant exposure to the region as customers delayed project decisions and ongoing operations were interrupted. Revenue from the Middle East and Asia rose 9% sequentially to $2.81 billion in the third quarter, even as it was down 6% from a year earlier. The Middle East is SLB's biggest market, accounting for 34% of total revenue in 2025. Activity improved in Iraq, Kuwait, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, although certain countries experienced renewed disruptions during the final weeks of the quarter, the company said in a statement. Latest data from Baker Hughes backed higher oilfield activity in the region. It showed total rig count, an indicator of future output, rose 4% sequentially to 504, while international rig count rose sequentially to 1,107 from 1,056. In North America, quarterly revenue rose 24% to $2.40 billion, driven by strength in US oil and gas drilling activity. "Combined with significant activity increases in Venezuela and expanding momentum across our Core, Digital and Data Center Solutions businesses, we see a very compelling outlook for 2027, with further upside as Middle East activity recovers," said CEO Olivier Le Peuch. In August, Reuters reported that SLB and Venezuela's state-run PDVSA had [USN:L1N43Q0UP TEXT:"signed a contract"] that granted the US company access to oilfield data from the country with the world's largest crude reserves. SLB in August acquired cooling equipment maker Kelvion for $4.1 billion, [USN:L4N44S0TP TEXT:"expanding its data center business"] amid an AI-driven boom in power and cooling infrastructure demand. The company posted an adjusted profit of 64 cents per share for the three months ended September 30, compared with analysts' estimate of 62 cents, according to data compiled by LSEG. Total revenue in the quarter came in at $9.45 billion, topping estimates of $9.28 billion.

item.title: China's foreign minister urges stronger governance of deep sea and outer space
item.description: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi called for stronger governance of the deep sea, polar regions and outer space as he addressed the opening of the country's Global Governance Forum in Xiongan on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi called for stronger governance of the deep sea, polar regions and outer space as he addressed the opening of the country's Global Governance Forum in Xiongan on Friday. Wang said artificial intelligence should remain under human control and be used for the benefit of humanity The rise of the Global South is the most momentous shift the world has seen since World War Two, Wang said, calling for greater representation of the Global South in international affairs Wang reiterated that the multilateral trading system should be safeguarded The 3-day forum, introduced last year by President Xi Jinping, is Beijing's diplomatic push for multilateralism and a reformed and more equitable global governance system as it sees the current system as deficient

item.title: Rabada and Smith renew rivalry before Cape Town decider
item.description: Quick bowler Kagiso Rabada's battles with Steve Smith sparked a combustible series the last time Australia played tests in South Africa eight years ago and the pair have resumed their rivalry as the teams head for a decisive contest in Cape Town next week.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gleeson
item.content:encoded: Quick bowler Kagiso Rabada's battles with Steve Smith sparked a combustible series the last time Australia played tests in South Africa eight years ago and the pair have resumed their rivalry as the teams head for a decisive contest in Cape Town next week. Rabada returned after a long hamstring injury layoff to help South Africa win by an[USN:L6N4680QI TEXT:" innings and 31 runs"] in the second test in Gqeberha on Thursday to square the three-match series and set up a potential thriller at Newlands, starting next Tuesday. Rabada's four second-innings wickets included that of the 37-year-old Smith, who, surprisingly early in his innings, out of character and with Australia in dire straits, attempted an ill-fated hook to a bouncer and top-edged a catch to midwicket. It was an injudicious decision from the former captain, who passed the milestone of 11,000 test runs at St George’s Park but made only three runs in the second innings as he looked out of sorts with a neck complaint. GETTING BEST PLAYER OUT “He wasn’t 100% fit in the game but we knew he had the ability to knuckle down and be the anchor for them; he’s done it for so long for Australia,” Rabada said in a TV interview. “He’s a top-class player and you can put a lot more pressure on a team when you get their best player out, so he’ll always be a prized wicket playing against Australia.” Rabada had also dismissed Smith at St George’s Park in 2018, the first of 11 wickets he took in that test, but he collided with the Australian while celebrating taking his wicket and was handed a two-match ban, later downgraded to a fine. The shoulder bump was among [USN:L8N1R33KU TEXT:"several incidents"] in an ill-spirited series that ended with the infamous ‘Sandpapergate’ [USN:L3N1RB3JT TEXT:"ball-tampering scandal"] after which Smith was stripped of the captaincy and banned for 12 months by Cricket Australia. NO GRUDGES, ONLY TESTOSTERONE Rabada, however, said there were no grudges and that it was part of intense competition. “As an athlete you want to go out and express yourself. There’s no hate off the field or anything like that. It’s a bunch of top-performing athletes who’ve got testosterone to burn. It’s the heat of the moment,” the South African paceman said. Smith has been back to Newlands since the scandal, playing in a T20 international two years after the incident, but this will be his first test at the venue since 2018. Last month he [USN:L4N4581PV TEXT:"said he had learned from the experience"] after being sent home in disgrace. "It was certainly a difficult period, particularly the initial period a few days after," Smith told Sydney's Daily Telegraph . "The mental state I was in was not great. That's somewhere I'd like not to get to again, but I certainly learned from that and have been able to move forward with my life. I've tried to kind of erase a lot of 2018 and what happened," he added. "I can't remember a lot about the series. I've tried to block most of it out of my memory bank."

item.title: US equity funds post inflows for a second straight week
item.description: US equity funds attracted inflows for a second consecutive week in the seven days to October 21, as easing Treasury yields and strong corporate earnings so far bolstered investor appetite, although caution over the artificial intelligence trade capped weekly net purchases.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US equity funds attracted inflows for a second consecutive week in the seven days to October 21, as easing Treasury yields and strong corporate earnings so far bolstered investor appetite, although caution over the artificial intelligence trade capped weekly net purchases. US equity funds recorded net inflows of $5.07 billion, a roughly 62% decline from $13.37 billion the week before, according to LSEG Lipper data. Easing US Treasury yields partly alleviated concerns over high borrowing costs, with the benchmark 10-year yield down nearly 38 basis points from its early-October peak of 5.3645%, a 24-1/2-year high. Investors also drew confidence from the solid start to the US earnings season. Nearly 24% of S&P 500 companies have reported, with roughly 82% topping analysts' average estimates, according to LSEG data. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) , however, fell 2.6% on Thursday after Meta (META.O) reported strong results on Wednesday but announced [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"plans"] to issue non-voting stock, reigniting concerns about rising capital commitments across the technology sector. Investors bought a net $8.63 billion of US large-cap funds and $1.92 billion of mid-cap funds during the week, while withdrawing a net $4.24 billion from small-cap funds. Sectoral funds attracted $1.8 billion in weekly inflows after two consecutive weeks of outflows, driven largely by $1.18 billion flowing into metals and mining funds. Technology and industrials funds also recorded net inflows of $429 million and $269 million, respectively. US bond funds recorded weekly outflows of $969 million, ending a 26-week streak of net purchases. Investors withdrew $3.3 billion from longer-dated government and Treasury fixed-income funds after three weeks of inflows, but invested $1.76 billion in short- to intermediate-term government and Treasury funds. They also added a notable $1.56 billion to municipal debt funds. Meanwhile, money market funds attracted $14.82 billion in weekly inflows, following roughly $45.93 billion in outflows the previous week.

item.title: India's Torrent Pharma's profit slips as R&D costs outweigh domestic demand
item.description: Indian drugmaker Torrent Pharmaceuticals reported a near 10% decline in second-quarter profit on Friday, as higher spending on research and development outpaced robust demand for chronic therapies in the country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian drugmaker Torrent Pharmaceuticals (TORP.NS) reported a near 10% decline in second-quarter profit on Friday, as higher spending on research and development outpaced robust demand for chronic therapies in the country. Consolidated net profit fell to 5.34 billion rupees for the quarter ended September 30, from 5.91 rupees a year earlier Torrent and peers such as Mankind Pharma (MNKI.NS) continue to benefit from strong demand for chronic therapies, particularly diabetes and cardiovascular treatments, helping drive steady growth in the domestic formulations business Sales in India, Torrent's biggest market, jumped 20% to 21.81 billion rupees, also boosted by strong demand for generic semaglutide — the active ingredient in Novo Nordisk's blockbuster diabetes drug Ozempic and weight-loss drug Wegovy The growth in domestic business helped lift overall revenue nearly 51% to 49.79 billion rupees The gain, however, was limited by nearly a 71% jump in total expenses, including a 35% increase in research and development costs The drugmaker's profit margins deteriorated to 10.7% from 17.9% a year earlier

item.title: India's Coforge posts strong quarterly growth on Encora integration, deal momentum
item.description: Indian IT services provider Coforge posted a 53.6% rise in second-quarter revenue on Friday, helped by a full-quarter contribution from acquired engineering-services company Encora and demand for AI-led engineering, data and cloud services.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian IT services provider Coforge (COFO.NS) posted a 53.6% rise in second-quarter revenue on Friday, helped by a full-quarter contribution from acquired engineering-services company Encora and demand for AI-led engineering, data and cloud services. Consolidated revenue from operations rose to 61.71 billion rupees ($649.99 million) in the quarter ended September 30, from 40.16 billion rupees a year earlier Consolidated net profit rose 56.5% year-on-year to 5.88 billion rupees from 3.76 billion rupees Indian IT firms are competing for large outsourcing and technology-transformation contracts as clients seek higher productivity from AI This comes even as concerns rise about AI's impact on traditional labour-intensive work Coforge, which derives over 60% of its revenue from North and South America, announced its $2.35 billion acquisition of AI firm Encora in December 2025 The acquisition would bolster Coforge's scale and capabilities in the US and Latin American markets, according to the firm Coforge's order intake for the quarter rose to $1.04 billion from $514 million a year ago The company, whose clients include Etihad Airways and fintech firm SEI Investments, said its top 10 customers accounted for 26.4% of second-quarter revenue ($1 = 94.9400 Indian rupees)

item.title: Canciller chino Wang insta a reforzar gestión de las aguas profundas y el espacio exterior
item.description: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de China, Wang Yi, pidió el viernes una gestión más sólida de las aguas profundas, las regiones polares y el espacio exterior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de China, Wang Yi, pidió el viernes una gestión más sólida de las aguas profundas, las regiones polares y el espacio exterior. En la inauguración del Foro de Gobernanza Global, Wang también afirmó que la inteligencia artificial debe permanecer bajo control humano y utilizarse en beneficio de la humanidad, al tiempo que pidió una mayor representación del Sur Global en los asuntos internacionales.

item.title: Rumanía culpa a Rusia de un ataque con dron a un carguero, que deja un muerto y tres desaparecidos
item.description: El presidente rumano, Nicusor Dan, acusó el viernes a Rusia de intensificar sus ataques contra el flanco oriental de la OTAN, después de que un ataque con drones hundiera un buque de carga frente a la costa rumana del mar Negro, causando la muerte al menos a un marinero y dejando a tres desaparecidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente rumano, Nicusor Dan, acusó el viernes a Rusia de intensificar sus ataques contra el flanco oriental de la OTAN, después de que un ataque con drones hundiera un buque de carga frente a la costa rumana del mar Negro, causando la muerte al menos a un marinero y dejando a tres desaparecidos. Las imágenes difundidas por las autoridades rumanas mostraban solo una pequeña parte del casco del buque cisterna volcado que aún se vislumbraba sobre las olas mientras se hundía. Las embarcaciones de emergencia rastreaban las aguas circundantes en busca de supervivientes en un mar agitado y con fuertes vientos. La autoridad naval rumana informó de que el Khoryv, con bandera de Comoras y una tripulación de 13 marineros ucranianos y azerbaiyanos, había enviado una señal de socorro a 13 millas náuticas del puerto rumano de Constanza, justo fuera del límite de las aguas territoriales rumanas. Nueve marineros fueron rescatados del agua, tres seguían desaparecidos y se recuperó un cadáver. En las últimas dos semanas se ha producido un repentino aumento de los ataques mortales contra buques mercantes frente a las costas de Rumanía y Bulgaria, países miembros de la OTAN, con al menos siete buques de carga alcanzados y unos 30 marineros fallecidos o desaparecidos. "Forma parte del proceso de escalada de Rusia en su guerra en Ucrania", dijo el presidente Dan a los periodistas, y añadió más tarde que el buque había sido alcanzado por un dron. La OTAN dijo el martes que enviaría más aviones de patrulla marítima, sistemas de radar y drones al mar Negro. La alianza no ha especificado qué medios se enviarían. El sábado, aviones de combate rumanos derribaron dos drones rusos de última generación sobre aguas territoriales rumanas. Los buques que han sido alcanzados últimamente se encontraban fondeados cerca del canal de Sulina, que une el río Danubio con el mar Negro, o se dirigían hacia él. El canal se ha convertido en la principal ruta de exportación de Ucrania, uno de los mayores exportadores mundiales de cereales y aceites alimentarios, que ha dependido de los puertos del Danubio y de las aguas territoriales rumanas, ya que Rusia ha atacado los puertos ucranianos del mar Negro. Ucrania, Rumanía y Bulgaria han pedido a la OTAN que redoble sus esfuerzos para proteger la navegación comercial en el mar Negro.

item.title: India central bank to impose new leverage rules for banks from April 1, 2027
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India issued final rules for bank leverage on Friday, following a draft proposal issued in August.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Reserve Bank of India issued final rules for bank leverage on Friday, following a draft proposal issued in August. The rules set the minimum leverage ratio for global systemically important banks in India at 3.5% and will take effect on April 1, 2027, the RBI said. Here are the details: Following the draft rules, banks suggested that the leverage ratio requirement for global systemically important lenders be aligned with the Basel minimum of 3% The RBI said it did not accept this feedback A bank's leverage ratio is its tier-1 capital divided by total assets The RBI added that it will impose capital distribution constraints on banks that do not meet that requirement, including restrictions on repatriation of profits Stakeholders had sought more time for implementation of the new rules, a request that the RBI rejected

item.title: BASF raises Evonik offer to €24 a share, source says
item.description: Germany-based BASF has increased its takeover offer for chemicals manufacturer Evonik Industries to €24 ($26.86) per share, a person close to BASF told Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Germany-based BASF (BASFn.DE) has increased its takeover offer for chemicals manufacturer Evonik Industries (EVKn.DE) to €24 ($26.86) per share, a person close to BASF told Reuters on Friday. Evonik declined comment. Bloomberg News first reported on Friday that BASF raised its offer for Evonik to more than €11 billion ($12.31 billion), citing people familiar with the matter. BASF's revised offer comes with guarantees on jobs and Evonik's productions sites. Evonik and BASF [USN:L8N45H0MN TEXT:"said"] in September that BASF had approached it about a possible takeover. Evonik's stock was up 3.1% at 1147 GMT, BASF shares were down 0.42%.

item.title: Revolution's Rasonque improves survival across subgroups in pancreatic cancer patients
item.description: Revolution Medicines said on Friday its recently approved pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque improved overall survival in previously treated patients, regardless of whether they carried an RAS mutation that drives tumor growth.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Revolution Medicines (RVMD.O) said on Friday its recently approved pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque improved overall survival in previously treated patients, regardless of whether they carried an RAS mutation that drives tumor growth. Here are more details from data presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology Congress in Madrid: Exploratory analyses showed Rasonque reduced the risk of death versus chemotherapy across all evaluated RAS subgroups by 39% to 68% in patients with RAS mutations and by 57% in those with no identified RAS mutation RAS mutations drive tumor growth and are found in more than 90% of pancreatic cancer cases The analysis was based on a late-stage study enrolling 500 previously treated patients, 248 of whom received Rasonque and 252 chemotherapy The once-daily pill won [USN:L4N44N16Y TEXT:"speedy US approval"] in August to treat metastatic pancreatic cancer in patients who had received prior treatment or could not receive combination chemotherapy Analyses showed Rasonque improved overall survival compared with several standard chemotherapy regimens Improvement in overall survival was also seen in previously treated patients, including those whose cancer spread within six months of earlier therapy and those who had received one prior treatment for metastatic disease

item.title: Novartis' breast cancer drug cuts risk of death by 19% after six years, data shows
item.description: Swiss drugmaker Novartis' drug Kisqali helped extend survival for women with a form of high-risk, early-stage breast cancer, cutting their risk of death by 19% after six years, according to trial data presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology congress in Madrid on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Bhanvi Satija
item.content:encoded: Swiss drugmaker Novartis' (NOVN.S) drug Kisqali helped extend survival for women with a form of high-risk, early-stage breast cancer, cutting their risk of death by 19% after six years, according to trial data presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology congress in Madrid on Friday. At six years, 91.9% of women who received Kisqali and hormone therapy were alive compared with 89.7% of those who received hormone therapy alone The survival gap grew from 1.2 percentage points at five years to 2.1 points at six years. The initial expectation was that it would take about 10 years of follow-up to show a survival difference. "Turns out we’re seeing a difference even sooner," said UCLA's Dennis Slamon, the trial's lead investigator Kisqali works by slowing cancer cells rather than killing them immediately. The longer cancer cells stay frozen, the more likely they are to permanently stop dividing and die The drug is already approved in the US and EU for patients with stage 2 or 3 breast cancer at high risk of recurrence. Analysts expect sales of the drug to be about $7 billion for this year, according to Visible Alpha estimates.

item.title: El euro se encamina a caída semanal frente a dólar y yen, por renovadas dudas sobre Francia
item.description: El euro se encaminaba el viernes a una pérdida semanal frente al dólar y el yen, ya que una nueva liquidación de bonos del Estado francés llevó el jueves la prima de riesgo de la deuda del país a niveles no vistos desde la crisis de deuda soberana de la zona euro en 2011.
item.dc:creator: Stefano Rebaudo
item.content:encoded: El euro se encaminaba el viernes a una pérdida semanal frente al dólar y el yen, ya que una nueva liquidación de bonos del Estado francés llevó el jueves la prima de riesgo de la deuda del país a niveles no vistos desde la crisis de deuda soberana de la zona euro en 2011. * El dólar también se vio sometido a presión durante la semana, ya que una ola de ventas en el mercado, impulsada por el sector tecnológico, puso de manifiesto que ya no atrae los habituales flujos hacia activos de refugio, mientras que las dudas sobre la sostenibilidad del auge de la inversión en inteligencia artificial alimentan las expectativas de una postura más cauta de la Reserva Federal. * Los estrategas señalaron que, aunque tanto el euro como el dólar se enfrentaron a presiones vendedoras esta semana, la moneda única fue la más afectada. * Por su parte, la moneda japonesa se disparó el jueves, ya que los inversores buscaron refugio ante la fragilidad de los mercados bursátiles y las preocupaciones sobre la trayectoria fiscal de Francia y los posibles nuevos disturbios callejeros. * El euro cedía un 0,15%, a 1,1198 dólares , en camino a cerrar la semana con un descenso del 0,42%. Su caída era más acusada frente al yen, tocando su mínimo desde octubre de 2025, a 175,42 unidades , con un declive del 0,24% y a las puertas de perder un 1,18% en la semana. * "El yen ha seguido cotizando en niveles más fuertes al final de la semana, impulsado por unas condiciones de mercado más reacias al riesgo", afirmó Lee Hardman, analista senior de divisas de MUFG. * El dólar cotizaba estable frente a su par japonés, a 156,73 yenes . Los estrategas indicaron que las alzas del yen se deben a la demanda de cobertura más que a los flujos de repatriación, ya que no hay indicios de que los inversores institucionales japoneses estén repatriando fondos. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas divisas, subía un 0,16%, a 101,75 unidades, tras haber tocado el jueves su nivel más bajo desde principios de mes, a 101,44. En la semana se encamina a un alza del 0,02%.

item.title: League would cancel Paris game if unsafe, Rodgers says
item.description: The NFL would have cancelled its first regular-season game in Paris, scheduled for Sunday, if the situation were unsafe, Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers said on Friday, referring to the recent protests in the French capital.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL would have cancelled its first regular-season game in Paris, scheduled for Sunday, if the situation were unsafe, Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers said on Friday, referring to the recent protests in the French capital. France experienced some of its worst urban unrest in years last weekend, prompting President Emmanuel Macron to tighten curbs on protests on Thursday amid fears that demonstrations planned for Saturday could turn violent. The Steelers face the New Orleans Saints at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis on Sunday, around 10 kilometres from Place de la Bastille, where Saturday's protests are expected to begin. Four-time NFL MVP Rodgers said he was confident the game would go ahead as planned. "I definitely think that the NFL is alert to what's going on," he told a press conference on Friday. "This game means a lot to the NFL. If it was unsafe, then I'm sure we wouldn't be here." The first NFL regular-season game in Paris has been largely overshadowed by the nationwide protests, with new demonstrations planned for Saturday. The Steelers informed fans on Thursday that a "Steelers House" fan event in the Bastille neighbourhood would not go ahead. The US State Department issued a security alert on Thursday night, calling on its citizens to "avoid demonstrations and areas of unrest". "Americans in Paris for the NFL game on Sunday, October 25 should also exercise caution and be aware of their surroundings," the US State Department added. But the unrest is not the only thing that has disrupted the build-up to the game, with Storm Austen hitting part of the country. Meteo France, the national weather agency, has issued orange alerts for much of the country's northwest, including the Paris region. The Steelers landed in France on Friday morning. They were due to practice at the Stade de France before holding a press conference. They eventually cancelled their training session due to bad weather, and the press conference was moved to their hotel in Paris. The Saints have been practising this week in Versailles after arriving in France on Monday. "Due to elevated wind and rain conditions, in accordance with local authorities, there will not be a media viewing portion during today's Saints practice," the Saints said in a statement. The NFL also cancelled a fan event on Friday. "NFL Experience Paris presented by Wilson is closed for the rest of today due to adverse weather. Please do not attend the site," the NFL said in a statement.

Pope Leo cancels Assisi visit to focus on post-cancer surgery recovery

Pope Leo has canceled a planned October 27 visit to the Italian town of Assisi in order to avoid a helicopter flight as he recovers from a recent surgery for lung cancer.

VATICAN CITY, Oct 23 (Reuters) – Pope Leo has canceled a planned October 27 visit to the Italian town of Assisi in order to avoid a helicopter flight as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said on Friday.

The 71-year-old pontiff made the decision on doctors’ advice, the Vatican said, as a separate statement from his surgeon and personal doctor said a chest examination showed excellent progress in Leo’s recovery.

The pope had the lower lobe of his right lung removed in surgery on October 13 and was diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer.

Show Full Article

The pope’s doctors said on Wednesday that further exams of the tissue removed in the operation had confirmed the cancer was localized and he would not require any further ongoing cancer treatments.

Leo had been due to travel on October 27 to Assisi, about 175 km (109 miles) north of Rome, for a peace event with other religious leaders.

“To support his recovery following thoracic surgery last Tuesday, and in accordance with doctors’ advice, Pope Leo XIV will be unable to attend,” the Vatican statement said.

Leo was discharged from hospital on Saturday and is gradually resuming his normal duties. On Wednesday, he returned to St Peter’s Square for his weekly audience with pilgrims.

The Vatican has not said whether the pope will be able to go ahead with a scheduled November 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

Reporting by Joshua McElwee, editing by Gavin Jones

item.title: Crescimento do setor manufatureiro do Japão desacelera para menor nível em 7 meses em outubro, diz PMI
item.description: O setor manufatureiro do Japão cresceu em outubro no ritmo mais lento dos últimos sete meses, à medida que o crescimento da produção e das novas encomendas desacelerou, segundo uma pesquisa empresarial divulgada nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O setor manufatureiro do Japão cresceu em outubro no ritmo mais lento dos últimos sete meses, à medida que o crescimento da produção e das novas encomendas desacelerou, segundo uma pesquisa empresarial divulgada nesta sexta-feira. O Índice de Gerentes de Compras (PMI) preliminar da S&P Global para o setor manufatureiro japonês caiu de 54,1 em setembro para 53,3 em outubro. Um valor acima de 50,0 indica expansão da atividade, enquanto um valor abaixo desse nível sinaliza contração. Os novos pedidos dos produtores de bens cresceram no ritmo mais fraco desde março, enquanto os novos negócios de exportação em todo o setor privado japonês aumentaram na taxa mais baixa em quatro meses. As indústrias registraram o menor aumento na produção desde março, enquanto os produtores de bens registraram o menor aumento nos novos pedidos desde março, segundo a pesquisa. O emprego nas fábricas cresceu a um ritmo moderado em outubro. Os fabricantes também aumentaram as atividades de compras, levando ao maior acúmulo de estoques de compras em quase quatro anos. A atividade no setor de serviços registrou um ligeiro aumento em outubro. O Índice PMI de Atividade Empresarial do Setor de Serviços do Japão da S&P Global (versão preliminar) subiu de 51,3 para 52,0, com a pesquisa indicando um aumento mais forte na atividade empresarial e um crescimento mais rápido das vendas. No nível da economia em geral, o Índice PMI Composto de Produção do Japão da S&P Global (preliminar) permaneceu inalterado em 52,3, marcando o 19º mês consecutivo de expansão na atividade do setor privado. “Os dados preliminares do PMI de outubro indicaram que o crescimento geral da atividade empresarial em todo o Japão permaneceu inalterado em relação ao mês anterior, continuando mais fraco do que a média acumulada no ano”, afirmou Usamah Bhatti, economista da S&P Global Market Intelligence. No setor privado, os novos negócios cresceram no ritmo mais lento dos últimos três meses, e o crescimento das exportações recuou para o menor nível em quatro meses. A criação de empregos desacelerou para o menor nível em 14 meses, enquanto a confiança para o próximo ano enfraqueceu para o nível mais baixo desde julho. A inflação dos custos dos insumos acelerou-se ligeiramente em outubro, impulsionada pelos custos mais elevados das matérias-primas e da mão de obra. As empresas continuaram a aumentar os preços de venda, embora a inflação dos preços de saída tenha recuado para o menor nível em quatro meses. (Reportagem de Satoshi Sugiyama)

item.title: Bond dealers see small rise in UK debt issuance after budget, more in 2027
item.description: British government bond dealers expect only a small rise in debt issuance this year after finance minister John Healey's first annual budget on October 28, but see higher borrowing coming down the track, according to a Reuters poll.
item.dc:creator: David Milliken
item.content:encoded: British government bond dealers expect only a small rise in debt issuance this year after finance minister John Healey's [USN:L1N460035 TEXT:"first annual budget"] on October 28, but see higher borrowing coming down the track, according to a Reuters poll. Mid-year revisions to issuance plans by the UK Debt Management Office are also likely to see a further shift away from sales of long-dated gilts, bringing them to their lowest share of total issuance since 1990. A Reuters poll of all 15 wholesale primary dealers in British government bonds showed a median expectation that the DMO will revise up its issuance plans for the 2026/27 financial year – [USN:S8N3YK07B TEXT:"last updated in April"] – by £3.4 billion to £249.6 billion ($335 billion) after next week's budget. "Gilt market participants should not expect too much in the way of fireworks," said Moyeen Islam, fixed income strategist at Barclays. "Attention will fall on the changes to the composition of issuance and the degree to which the profile for the medium-term gross financing requirement incorporates a credible fiscal strategy," he added. Net issuance of short-dated Treasury bills – which the DMO often uses to smooth out in-year changes in financing needs – is expected to double to £10 billion from £5 billion, according to the median forecast. LONG-DATED ISSUANCE HEADING FOR LOWEST SHARE SINCE 1990 Meanwhile, issuance plans for long-dated government bonds with maturities of more than 15 years look set to be scaled back further to their lowest since 1990, making up less than 7% of issuance, down from 11% last year and over 30% in 2021. Twenty- and 30-year gilt yields hit their highest since 1998 earlier this month as part of a global selloff driven by worries about high borrowing across advanced economies and inflation fuelled by the US-Iran war. While long-dated gilts were once a mainstay of British government debt issuance – giving the country the longest average debt maturity of any major economy, and some insulation against rising interest rates – demand from domestic pension funds has now largely faded. Instead, primary dealers, known in Britain as gilt-edged market makers (GEMMs), are looking for more detail of government plans to increase net financing through Treasury bills. Following a review earlier this year, the government plans to issue a 12-month Treasury bill in early 2027 and to work on expanding the overall size of the market, which only accounts for about 3% of British government financing compared with 5% in Germany and over 20% in the United States. RBC predicted that T-bills could make up a net £25 billion of financing in the upcoming 2027/28 financial year. Overall, GEMMs polled by Reuters predicted a £14 billion increase to public-sector net borrowing for 2026/27 and a £16 billion upward revision for 2027/28, relative to budget forecasts in March. The gross financing requirement for the next financial year – a closer proxy for financing needed through gilt and T-bill sales – is expected to be revised up by £27 billion from March's estimate to £334 billion. This would still leave the budget deficit on course to fall from £129 billion this year to £112 billion in 2027/28, its lowest as a share of GDP since the COVID-19 pandemic. But Healey's headroom against a longer-term target, balancing non-investment spending against tax revenue by 2029/30, is expected to narrow to £15 billion from £24 billion forecast in March. That headroom is slightly greater than the £12 billion median in a [USN:L1N4610D3 TEXT:"Reuters poll of economists"] last week, but economists expect it to come under further pressure, as higher inflation is squeezing already-tight future spending plans. "While the Budget looks set to be a relatively low-key affair, it will probably set up a difficult Spending Review next year," said James Moberly, UK economist at GEMM Goldman Sachs. "Existing departmental spending plans look very tight ... but funding higher outlays will be challenging unless the economic outlook improves," he added. Reuters poll (Oct 2026) DMO remit (April 2026) OBR forecast (March 2026) Gross gilt issuance 2026/27 £249.6 billion £246.2 billion Net T-bill issuance 2026/27 £10 billion £5 billion Gross financing requirement 2027/28 £334.3 billion £307.6 billion PSNB 2026/27 £129.4 billion £115.5 billion PSNB 2027/28 £112 billion £96.5 billion Short-dated gilt issuance 2026/27 43% 39% Medium-dated gilt issuance 35% 31% Long-dated gilt issuance 7% 9% Index-linked gilt issuance 10% 9% Unallocated gilt issuance 5% 12% ($1 = 0.7464 pounds)

item.title: EU ministers vow to tackle 'China Shock 2.0' through talks with Beijing
item.description: The European Union should strike deals with Beijing to curb imports in sectors such as chemicals, machinery and pharmaceuticals, EU ministers said on Friday, as the bloc faces an 'unsustainable' and damaging goods trade deficit with China.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: The European Union should strike deals with Beijing to curb imports in sectors such as chemicals, machinery and pharmaceuticals, EU ministers said on Friday, as the bloc faces an 'unsustainable' and damaging goods trade deficit with China. European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic earlier this month [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"agreed with Beijing"] for the EU to cut imports of hybrid vehicles from China by more than half to address a deficit that has swelled to more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day, and to support Europe's struggling carmakers. Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee told reporters dialogue with China could be a stepping stone "to look to more industries and sectors where we can address that imbalance." China needs foreign buyers for the flood of relatively cheap state-subsidised goods its own shoppers can't absorb, and the EU is torn between welcoming those imports to ease living costs and keeping them out to rebuild its own factories. The EU's goods trade deficit swelled to more than €370 billion ($415.07 billion) in 2025 and is on course to break well past €400 billion this year, a situation European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has called "unsustainable". European industry says the export surge, dubbed China Shock 2.0, is already causing factory closures and job losses, most notably the [USN:L8N44W0B8 TEXT:"100,000 positions set to go"] at Volkswagen. China has said in the past it is not the root cause of the EU's problems, but a partner in solving them. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said this week there were growing concerns for chemicals and machinery. Lithuania Foreign Minister Kestutis Budrys said on Friday that pharmaceuticals could also be included. Ministers did not go into potential short-term measures the EU could take in parallel to discussions with Beijing. Greece Deputy Foreign Minister Haris Theoharis said the EU had held talks with China for years without results, but these were now forthcoming. "We should be continuing to engage in this process, and of course keep all the options open," he said before the meeting of trade ministers. France's junior minister for trade, Nicolas Forissier, said dialogue was possible now that the EU was speaking as one. Chinese authorities "understand when you are clear, when you speak frankly, when you are firm on your positions," he said. ($1 = 0.8914 euros)

item.title: UK tells public to keep three days' emergency supplies at home
item.description: The British government advised the public on Friday to keep three days of emergency supplies at home, a message it said had been hammered home by this week's PHP software glitch, as well as a record-setting summer of heat, drought and wildfires.
item.dc:creator: Sam Tabahriti
item.content:encoded: The British government advised the public on Friday to keep three days of emergency supplies at home, a message it said had been hammered home by this week's PHP software glitch, as well as a record-setting summer of heat, drought and wildfires. Governments and businesses worldwide [USN:L1N468095 TEXT:"have rushed"] to secure systems running the PHP programming language after flaws [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"were disclosed"] on Wednesday, forcing some services offline and triggering millions of hacking attempts in one of the most significant cybersecurity incidents in recent years. The British government said the internet outage showed the importance of its newly launched "Be Ready" campaign, which advises the public to keep three days of bottled water and non-perishable food in the house. Prime Minister Andy Burnham, hosting a meeting on the response to wildfires, said that in the past Britain had been "on the back foot" responding to emergencies and that it needed to be more proactive. The government announced a new wildfire response plan that includes deploying [USN:L8N46823G TEXT:"military aircraft"]. Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said cyber incidents such as the PHP outage would become more common as AI made it easier to find ways to thwart traditional defences. He also cited risks from hostile states, organised criminals and climate change. The UK was facing a greater level of threat "than we have certainly for most, if not all, of my lifetime", he said during an appearance on the BBC's "Question Time" programme broadcast overnight. Britain's advice is similar to that issued by the European Commission, which told EU citizens last year to [USN:S8N3P3098 TEXT:"keep a 72-hour emergency kit"] containing supplies such as food, water, cash and power banks.

item.title: World marathon champion Jepchirchir provisionally banned by AIU over EPO finding
item.description: Kenya's world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for the banned blood booster EPO in a sample taken before her Sydney Marathon victory, the Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Pearl Nazare
item.content:encoded: Kenya's world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for the banned blood booster EPO in a sample taken before her Sydney Marathon victory, the Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) said on Friday. The AIU added that the out-of-competition sample collected in Kenya returned an adverse analytical finding for EPO (erythropoietin), which boosts the production of red blood cells. "I can only say that I feel terrible about what happened and I think it's only right that an athlete who uses the performance enhancing drugs should be disqualified," her agent Gianni Demadonna said in an emailed statement. The 33-year-old is a former Olympic champion and half-marathon world record holder as well as a four-times World Marathon Majors winner. She won gold at the Tokyo Games in 2021 and has also claimed major marathon victories in New York (2021), Boston (2022), London (2024) and [USN:L4N44M02U TEXT:"Sydney (2026)"] . Jepchirchir dominated the women's race in Sydney in August, pulling clear of the field to finish in 2:18:31, more than three minutes ahead of second-placed compatriot Irine Cheptai. Last year, Kenya's women's marathon world record holder [USN:L1N3W40NI TEXT:"Ruth Chepngetich"] was banned for three years after admitting anti-doping rule violations involving hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ), a prohibited diuretic, though her world record of 2:09:56 remained on the books because it was set before her positive test.

item.title: ヘッジファンドの運用成績悪化、ＡＩ投資懸念でテック株売り拡大
item.description:
Summer Zhen Anirban Sen
[香港 ２３日 ロイター] - 世界のヘッジファンドは今週、テクノロジ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ヘッジファンドの運用成績悪化、ＡＩ投資懸念でテック株売り拡大 20:13 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所の取引フロア、8月21日撮影 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo

Summer Zhen　Anirban Sen

[香港 ２３日 ロイター] - 世界のヘッジファンドは今週、テクノロジー株の再評価に伴う売りに見舞われ、主要な運用戦略は１日の損失が新型コロナウイルス禍の市場急落時以来の大きさとなった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の巨額投資に対する懐疑的な見方が強まり、大型ハイテク株が再び売られた。売りは世界の市場に広がり、ヘッジファンドに大きな打撃を与えた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのプライムブローカレッジ部門は顧客向けリポートで「先週の木曜日がひどいと感じたのなら、きょうはそれ以上にひどい」と記した。

ゴールドマンが集計する主要３戦略（ファンダメンタル株式ロングショート、システマティック、マルチストラテジー）は、２２日にそろって１％超の損失を記録した。コロナ禍以来初めてとなる。

今回の売りのきっかけの一つは、ＡＩモデルの構築に数十億ドルを投じるハイパースケーラーの一角、メタ・プラットフォームズが資金調達に向けて新たな種類の株式を発行すると発表したことだった。

メタは２２日に７％下落し、７月以来の大幅安となった。エヌビディアは４％下落。ナスダック総合指数は２．６％下落し、６月５日以来の大幅な下落率を記録した。アジアの株式市場も売りの中心となった。原油高と巨額のＡＩ投資への懸念が重しとなった。

市場関係者によると、この下落を受けてヘッジファンドはレバレッジの縮小に動いた。投資が集中するＡＩ関連の取引で損失が発生し、投資家はポジションの縮小とリスクの抑制を迫られた。

ゴールドマンの推計によると、銘柄選別型の世界のファンダメンタル・ロングショート・ファンドは１０月に入って３．８％下落した。中国株やテクノロジー株の保有に伴う損失に加え、空売りが集中する銘柄の踏み上げが運用成績を圧迫したという。

ゴールドマンによると、２２日までの月間成績では、テクノロジー株を中心に投資するヘッジファンドとアジアを中心に投資するヘッジファンドが、それぞれ約１０％、約９％下落し、特に大きな損失を出した。

東京を拠点とするヘッジファンド、トライヴィスタ・キャピタルのパートナー、後藤正樹氏は、同社が６月下旬以降、ハードウエアへの投資を減らしてきたと述べた。ＡＩの可能性を強く信じているとしながらも、投資の集中度が驚くほど高いと指摘。ＩＴバブルの時も同じように投資の集中があったとし、循環的な資金調達にも多少の懸念があると語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 20:13 ロイター

item.title: Russia and Ukraine have swapped 270 prisoners of war each, Russian state media reports
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have exchanged 270 prisoners of war each, Russian state news agencies reported on Friday, citing the Defence Ministry.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia and Ukraine have exchanged 270 prisoners of war each, Russian state news agencies reported on Friday, citing the Defence Ministry. The ministry was cited as saying that the freed Russian servicemen were in Belarus and would be transported to Russia once they had received psychological and medical assistance. Thousands of prisoners have been exchanged since the start of the full-scale war in Ukraine in February 2022, one of the few areas where Moscow and Kyiv have maintained on-off contacts despite the conflict.

FAST

Oct 23 : Global equity funds attracted inflows for a fifth consecutive week in the week through October 21, as easing Treasury yields and strong early corporate earnings lifted investor sentiment. Global equity funds drew net inflows of $28.16 billion during the week, compared with $19.88 billion in the previous week, LSEG Lipper data showed. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield fell about 15 basis points last week and dropped below the psychologically significant 5 per cent level this week. Fund investors were encouraged by better-than-expected corporate earnings so far this reporting season.

Of the nearly 18 per cent of MSCI All Country World Index constituents that have reported earnings to date, about 73 per cent have exceeded the average analyst estimate, according to LSEG data. The MSCI World Index, however, fell 1.31 per cent on Thursday after Meta reported strong results on Wednesday but unveiled plans to issue non-voting stock, reviving concerns about its growing capital commitments. By region, Asian equity funds attracted $11.53 billion, their largest weekly inflow since at least December 2022. Investors also added $9.14 billion to European equity funds and $5.07 billion to US equity funds. Among sectoral funds, technology attracted $5.05 billion, reversing net sales of $4.77 billion in the previous week. Investors also bought $1.83 billion in healthcare sector funds but sold a notable $1.29 billion in consumer discretionary sector funds. Global bond funds remained popular for a fifth consecutive week, attracting net inflows of $9.44 billion. Swiss franc-denominated bond funds drew $6.8 billion, their largest weekly inflow since at least November 2024. Investors also added a significant $2.78 billion to short-term bond funds, while pulling $1.68 billion from high-yield bond funds and $550 million from government bond funds. Money market funds attracted weekly net inflows of $15.86 billion, following net outflows of $47.51 billion the previous week. Among commodities, gold and other precious metals funds attracted net inflows of $1.29 billion, marking their fifth week of net purchases in the past six weeks. Investors also added $41.5 million to energy funds. Data covering 29,174 emerging market funds showed that investors bought $6.28 billion worth of equity funds — the largest weekly net purchase since August 5. However, they withdrew a marginal $48.72 million from bond funds.

Source: Reuters
