item.title: AmEx lifts 2026 profit forecast as travel, entertainment spending drives growth
item.description: American Express raised its 2026 profit forecast above Wall Street expectations on Friday after reporting strong third-quarter results, as a sharp increase in airline spending helped drive growth in its travel and entertainment business.
item.dc:creator: Manya Saini
item.content:encoded: American Express (AXP.N) raised its 2026 profit forecast above Wall Street expectations on Friday after reporting strong third-quarter results, as a sharp increase in airline spending helped drive growth in its travel and entertainment business. Airlines worldwide have raised ticket prices in recent months as they grapple with surging fuel prices stemming from the Middle East conflict and disruptions to global oil flows. AmEx's travel and entertainment spending rose 10% in the third quarter from a year earlier, led by a 13% jump in the airline category and a 9% rise in the restaurant category. "Of course, there is some impact here from the average ticket size and airline price increases," Chief Financial Officer Christophe Le Caillec told Reuters in an interview, referring to the airline segment. By targeting affluent consumers with high credit scores and more disposable income, the credit card giant has built a moat around its business to keep broader economic slowdowns and uncertainty at bay. Billed business, a measure of total spending on all AmEx-issued cards, rose 8% in the third quarter to $454 billion. Revenue climbed 9% to $20.1 billion. AmEx expects full-year adjusted profit in the range of $17.60 to $17.90 per share, with the mid-point well above estimates of $17.63, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company has invested heavily in attracting younger consumers, particularly Gen Z and millennials, as it seeks to build long-term customer relationships and expand its global market share to sustain growth. AmEx posted an adjusted profit $4.68 per share in the quarter ended September 30, sailing past Wall Street expectations of about $4.48. The stock fell 1.3% in volatile premarket trading after the results. If the decline holds, it would mark the ninth time in 11 quarters that the stock has fallen despite results beating expectations, Truist analyst Brian Foran wrote in a note. "Maybe we all work too hard, and the investor strategy is just short the quarter, long the rest," he added.

item.title: Romania blames Russia for drone that sinks cargo ship; 1 killed, 3 missing
item.description: Romanian President Nicusor Dan accused Russia of escalating its attacks on NATO's eastern flank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Romanian President Nicusor Dan accused Russia of escalating its attacks on NATO's eastern flank on Friday, after a drone strike sank a cargo ship off the Romanian Black Sea coast, killing at least one sailor with three still missing. Video released by Romanian authorities showed only a small part of the hull of the capsized tanker still visible above the waves as it sank. Emergency vessels were searching the surrounding waters for survivors in choppy seas and high wind. Romania's naval authority said the Comoros-flagged Khoryv, with a crew of 13 Ukrainian and Azeri sailors, had sent a distress signal 13 nautical miles off Romania's port of Constanta, just beyond Romanian territorial waters. Nine sailors were rescued from the water, three were missing and one body was recovered. The past two weeks have seen a sudden surge in deadly attacks on commercial ships off the coasts of NATO members Romania and Bulgaria, with at least [USN:L8N4610EC TEXT:"seven cargo ships"] hit and some 30 sailors reported dead or missing. "It is part of Russia's escalation process in its war in Ukraine," President Dan told reporters, later saying the ship had been hit by a drone. [USN:L6N46613E TEXT:"NATO"] said on Tuesday it would send more maritime patrol aircraft, radar systems and drones to the Black Sea. The alliance has not specified what capabilities would be sent. On Saturday, Romanian jets [USN:L1N46306E TEXT:"shot down"] two of the latest generation of Russian drones over Romanian territorial waters. The vessels that have been struck lately have either been anchored near or headed towards the Sulina Canal, which links the Danube River to the Black Sea. The canal has become the primary export route for Ukraine, one of the world's biggest grain and food oil exporters, which has relied on Danube River ports and Romanian territorial waters as Russia has attacked Ukraine's own Black Sea ports. Ukraine, Romania and Bulgaria have called on NATO to do more to protect commercial shipping in the Black Sea.

FAST

BENGALURU, Oct 23 Reuters) - Infosys trimmed its annual revenue growth forecast on Friday despite marginally beating estimates for quarterly revenue after demand from its energy and utility clients picked up. Revenue at India's second-largest IT services provider rose 10.7 per cent to 492.44 billion rupees ($5.19 billion) in the July-September period.  Analysts on average had estimated revenue of 491.32 billion rupees, according to data compiled by LSEG.  The company revised its revenue growth forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 to 1 per cent-2 per cent from its earlier estimate of up 1.5 per cent-3 per cent.

Most analysts had expected the company to downgrade the upper-end of the range to 1.5 per cent to 2.5 per cent. The rise of AI has hurt India's $315 billion IT industry, forcing companies to overhaul their business models and offer steep discounts. Despite AI unlocking newer revenue streams, it is challenging the traditional revenue as clients are increasingly tying fees to technology-led productivity gains instead of hours worked.   Peers Tata Consultancy Services and HCLTech both met their revenue estimates earlier this week, but their investors cheered AI revenue uptick with their stocks surging. Revenue from Infosys' energy business, its third-largest revenue contributor, rose 7.3 per cent from a year earlier after stripping out currency fluctuations. The overall revenue rose 1.5 per cent, excluding the currency impact. The Bengaluru-based tech major's net profit rose 6.2 per cent to 78.23 billion rupees in the three-month period, falling below 79.29 billion rupees expected by analysts, as per LSEG-compiled data.  Deal wins stood at $5.2 billion during the quarter, compared with $3.1 billion in the year-ago quarter.  The company's Mumbai-listed shares closed flat ahead of the results, with a basket of IT stocks dropping 0.3 per cent. ($1 = 94.9400 Indian rupees)

Wall Street futures dip after AI rout, telecoms slide

FAST

Oct 23 : Wall Street futures ticked lower on Friday as caution prevailed after a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks over concerns about the sector's massive funding requirements, while telecom shares slid on fears of increased competition from SpaceX. AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile were down over 3 per cent in premarket trading after a report said SpaceX was in talks with cellular infrastructure companies about launching a nationwide wireless carrier program. US cell tower operators, however, gained from this news, with Crown Castle up 8.5 per cent and American Tower up 5.6 per cent. SpaceX shares gained 2.2 per cent. AI-related shares swung sharply this week, first coming under pressure over CoreWeave's debt burden and the cost of financing AI investment, then rallying on Wednesday after upbeat results from SpaceX and Super Micro.

The gains reversed on Thursday and the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell nearly 3 per cent. The slide accelerated following Meta's nearly 8 per cent decline after the Facebook parent reported its first cash outflow in more than a decade amid concerns over its AI-related expenditures. In premarket trading on Friday, CoreWeave rose 2 per cent, while 'Magnificent 7' stocks were mixed, with up 0.7 per cent and Microsoft down 0.6 per cent. At 06:09 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were down 308 points, or 0.58 per cent, and S&P 500 E-minis were down 15.5 points, or 0.2 per cent. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 0.75 points, or flat. Brent crude held near a more than five-month high amid Middle East supply concerns, adding to inflation worries ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy meeting next week. Nasdaq was on track for a weekly loss, while the benchmark S&P 500 and the blue-chip Dow remained higher for the week, supported by gains in defensive sectors as investors sought refuge from the volatility in technology stocks. Market focus remains on the earnings season. American Express and SLB, among others, are set to report later in the day. S&P 500's third-quarter profit growth is now forecast at 32.3 per cent, up from 30.7 per cent previously, according to LSEG data. In other premarket moves, gold miner Newmont fell 1.5 per cent after reporting quarterly results and warning that unit costs are expected to trend higher in 2027. Bloom Energy rose 1.7 per cent after the energy firm raised its fiscal 2026 forecast.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded: Wall Street futures ticked lower on Friday as caution prevailed after a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks over concerns about the sector's massive funding requirements, while telecom shares slid on fears of increased competition from SpaceX. AT&T (T.N) , Verizon (VZ.N) and T-Mobile (TMUS.O) were down more than 4% in premarket trading after a [USN:L4N4682CX TEXT:"report said"] SpaceX (SPCX.O) was in talks with cellular infrastructure companies about launching a nationwide wireless carrier program. US cell tower operators, however, gained from this news, with Crown Castle (CCI.N) up 8.6% and American Tower (AMT.N) up 6.1%. SpaceX shares gained 1.5%. AI-related shares swung sharply this week, first coming under pressure over CoreWeave's (CRWV.O) [USN:L4N4620ZT TEXT:"debt burden"] and the cost of financing AI investment, then rallying on Wednesday after upbeat results from SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Super Micro (SMCI.O) . The gains reversed on Thursday and the tech-heavy Nasdaq (.IXIC) fell nearly 3%. The slide accelerated following Meta's (META.O) nearly 8% [USN:L6N468125 TEXT:"decline"] after the Facebook parent reported its first cash outflow in more than a decade amid concerns over its AI-related expenditures. On Friday, CoreWeave shares were flat, and 'Magnificent 7' stocks were little changed, with Meta down 0.6%. Market focus remains on the earnings season, with major companies such as Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) reporting next week. "Given the concentration of these companies within US indices, their results could have significant implications for broader market sentiment," said Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com. "Investors are becoming increasingly demanding when it comes to AI investment, with attention shifting from revenue growth towards profitability, capital expenditure and tangible returns." At 07:19 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were down 314 points, or 0.59%, and S&P 500 E-minis were down 19.25 points, or 0.25%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 33.75 points, or 0.12%. Brent crude held near a more than five-month high amid Middle East supply concerns, adding to inflation worries ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy meeting next week. Nasdaq was on track for a weekly loss, while the benchmark S&P 500 and the blue-chip Dow remained higher, supported by gains in defensive sectors as investors sought refuge from volatility in technology stocks. S&P 500's third-quarter profit growth is now forecast at 32.3%, up from 30.7% previously, according to LSEG data. In other premarket moves, gold miner Newmont (NEM.N) fell 1.3% after [USN:L4N46825R TEXT:"reporting quarterly"] results and warning that unit costs are expected to trend higher in 2027. Bloom Energy (BE.N) dipped 1.6% even after the [USN:L1N46819F TEXT:"energy firm raised"] its fiscal 2026 forecast.

item.title: 香港取引所、ＡＩと半導体の指数導入 中国でＡＩ指数ライセンス
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] - 香港取引所（ＨＫＥＸ）は２３日、ＡＩ（人工知能）と半導体の企業を対象とした２つの新指数を導...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
香港取引所、ＡＩと半導体の指数導入　中国でＡＩ指数ライセンス 19:39 配信

香港取引所（ＨＫＥＸ）のロゴ REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[２３日 ロイター] - 香港取引所（ＨＫＥＸ）は２３日、ＡＩ（人工知能）と半導体の企業を対象とした２つの新指数を導入するとともに、このＡＩ指数をベンチマークとする中国本土での上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）に関するライセンス契約を南方基金と締結した。

詳細は以下の通り。

• 「ＨＫＥＸ人工知能指数」はＡＩバリューチェーンへの高いエクスポージャーを持つ香港上場企業４０社を構成銘柄に。

• 同指数はＡＩエコシステムの５つの層（チップ設計、データセンター、ＡＩインフラ、ＡＩモデル、ソフトウエア・フィジカルアプリケーション）を網羅。

• 「ＨＫＥＸ半導体指数」は、香港に上場する半導体関連企業上位３０社を構成銘柄に。

• 対象分野は半導体製造、装置、電子部品、コンピューティングハードウエア、ストレージ。

• 構成銘柄はＡＩ関連の研究開発および設備投資を積極的に行っている企業を優先する方法に基づいて選定。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 19:39 ロイター

item.title: The world's oldest cave paintings in Indonesia under threat of wildfires
item.description: In a cave in South Sulawesi's Maros-Pangkep, an artwork depicting human-like figures interacting with a pig was dated by researchers from Australia's Griffith University to be at least 51,200 years old.
item.dc:creator: CNA

The world's oldest cave paintings in Indonesia under threat of wildfires

In a cave in South Sulawesi's Maros-Pangkep, an artwork depicting human-like figures interacting with a pig was dated by researchers from Australia's Griffith University to be at least 51,200 years old.

A rock painting depicting a pig at a cave in Maros-Pangkep, South Sulawesi province, Indonesia, Oct 12, 2026. (Photo: National Research and Innovation Agency/Handout via Reuters)

FAST

MAROS-PANGKEP, Indonesia: The world's oldest cave paintings on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi are under threat as heat and smoke from the country's worst wildfires in more than a decade risk accelerating the deterioration of the more than 67,000-year-old works of art, researchers said. Indonesia is battling its most intense forest and land fires since 2015 as a severe El Nino drives up temperatures and reduces rainfall, leaving its forest and peatland vulnerable to fire. While the islands of Sumatra and Borneo are the worst affected by the disaster, fires have also spread on the island of Sulawesi, including in South Sulawesi where limestone caves house the world's oldest prehistoric art.  In a cave in South Sulawesi's Maros-Pangkep, an artwork depicting human-like figures interacting with a pig was dated by researchers from Australia's Griffith University to be at least 51,200 years old. In a cave on Muna island, off Sulawesi, a reddish-coloured hand stencil was dated to at least 67,800 years.

Near the Maros-Pangkep cave, firefighters worked to put out fires as smoke drifted over the dramatic karst landscape that is a defining feature of the national park and UNESCO Global Geopark surrounding the cave. Firefighter Muhammad Ikfar said fires burned near the site for more than a week earlier this month and came within 800m of the cave. More than 270 hectares of the national park burned between Sep 30 and Oct 18, Ikfar said.  "The first and most destructive effect is the heat. Even without direct fire touching the paintings, it could ruin them because it changes the temperature around the paintings and accelerates the process of corrosion," said Griffith University archaeologist Basran Burhan. The smoke also creates soot. "They create soot on the paintings and cover them, so that the paintings will become blurred and difficult to identify," he said. On Thursday (Oct 22) and Friday, firefighters were working to put out fires in other parts of the park, firefighter Ikfar said, adding that the conditions were dry with no rain yet. "If we don't do something about this quick, if there isn't any tactical mitigation efforts for this incident we will lose one of the most amazing evidence of human history in Maros-Pangkep," Burhan said. "And that is a great shame."

item.title: カナダ首相、トルコとの協議でＬＧＢＴＱ＋権利提起
item.description:
Maria Cheng Tuvan Gumrukcu
［イスタンブール ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Cheng　Tuvan Gumrukcu

［イスタンブール　２３日　ロイター］ - トルコを公式訪問しているカナダのカーニー首相は２３日、前日に行われたトルコ政府との会合で、カナダ側がＬＧＢＴＱ＋（性的少数者）の権利を巡る問題を提起したと明らかにした。その上で、カナダがパートナーシップ関係を持つことは相手国の政策の承認を意味しないと述べた。イスタンブールで記者団に語った。

カーニー氏は２２日、エルドアン大統領と貿易・投資、防衛・安全保障、エネルギー、社会・外交関係を柱とする新たな戦略的パートナーシップに署名した。

トルコでは２０２４年以降、野党への締め付けが続いている。これに加え、９月以降はＬＧＢＴＱ＋団体を標的とした締め付けが行われ、人権団体や欧州の一部当局者から批判が出ている。トルコ政府は司法は独立していると主張し、捜査や裁判に政治的な動機はないとしている。

カーニー氏はこれまで、カナダが人権侵害があると見なす国々と関わることは、その国の政策を支持することを意味しないと述べてきた。

同氏は「関与しているからこそ、こうした国々の高官に対し、われわれが世界をどう見ているか、何を期待しているかを直接伝えることができる」と語った。トルコ滞在中、ＬＧＢＴＱ＋団体や人権団体の指導者とは面会していない。

item.title: サウジ、高性能化へミサイル工場拡張か 衛星画像を米研究者分析
item.description:
Jonathan Landay
[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jonathan Landay

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアはより遠くまで飛べる、あるいはより重い弾頭を搭載できる大型の固体燃料ミサイルを製造するため、弾道ミサイル工場を拡張しているとみられる。米国の研究者２人が１年以上にわたる商用衛星画像を分析し、明らかにした。

より高性能なミサイルは、サウジがイランによる攻撃を抑止し、軍事的な自立性を高めるのに役立つ可能性があるほか、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派戦闘員との紛争でサウジの立場を強化する可能性もある。

一方で、地域のミサイル開発競争を激化させる恐れがあり、すでに核拡散への懸念が高まっている米サウジ間の民生用原子力協定に対する米議会の反対をさらに強める可能性もある。

米国に拠点を置く衛星企業プラネット・ラボは、２０２５年４月から２６年９月にかけて、リヤドの西約２００キロに位置するドゥワディミ複合施設の画像を撮影。米シンクタンク「外交政策研究所（ＦＰＲＩ）」のサム・レア氏とマイケル・ドゥイツマン氏の研究者２人は、これらの画像にはキャスティングピット（ミサイルのモーターケースに燃料成分の混合物を注ぎ込み、固めるための井戸）を収容する新しい建物が写っていると分析した。

サウジの大使館と情報省はコメント要請に応じなかった。

両氏は近隣の建物を偶発的な爆発から守るための壁と思われるものに囲まれたこの建物について、既存のキャスティングピットを収容していると考えられている建物の少なくとも２倍の大きさだと評価。「（この画像は）サウジがミサイル生産施設インフラを拡張していることを示唆しており、おそらくより大きなペイロード（搭載弾頭重量）を運搬したり、より長い射程距離に到達できたりする大型ミサイルを生産するためだろう」と記した。

レア、ドゥイツマンの両氏、そして英国際戦略研究所（ＩＩＳＳ）と調査分析機関ＣＮＡの専門家らはロイターに対し、サウジのミサイル部隊の構成から、ドゥワディミ複合施設は中国の技術に依存していることが示唆されると述べた。両氏はその特徴も中国のミサイル工場と類似していると指摘した。

サウジが中国に接近したのは、米国が長年にわたり長距離ミサイルシステムの輸出を制限してきたためと考えられている。

中国の大使館と国防省はコメント要請に応じなかった。ホワイトハウスもコメント要請に応じなかった。

Oct 23 : Estonian ride-hailing firm Bolt and the Greater Paris region are planning to launch an autonomous driving programme in the French capital in 2028, using vehicles from Franco-Italian Stellantis, they said in a joint statement on Friday. The pilot programme will assess gaps in existing transport services, with an aim to launch commercial operations in Greater Paris, which includes the city's surrounding municipalities, by 2030, the three parties to the agreement said. • Initial deployments are planned across municipalities in the north-west of the metropolitan area • "This experiment will also help inform public decision-making and define the conditions for potential wider deployment," said Patrick Ollier, president of the Metropolis of Greater Paris

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 23 : US stock investors face a pivotal week, with corporate earnings reports led by major AI players and a Federal Reserve meeting both posing critical tests for a suddenly shaky market rally. Weakness in technology shares left investors on edge about the state of the AI trade that has driven the US equity bull market that just marked its fourth anniversary. The AI pullback deepened on Thursday, with the Nasdaq Composite posting its biggest one-day drop since June. Investors were disappointed by quarterly reports from Meta and Lam Research. Meta is one of the hyperscalers spending massively to build out data centers, while Lam is a high-flying semiconductor company, one of a group that has been among the biggest AI stock winners. Three other hyperscalers - Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon - headline a packed week of quarterly results, including about one-third of S&P 500 companies. The Fed's interest rate policy meeting on Wednesday also could rattle markets.

"There are a lot of balls in the air," said Nick Giorgi, chief equity strategist at Alpine Macro.  "Next week, you have a lot more tech earnings, and right now the market is taking a discerning eye as it relates to all the spending that goes along with artificial intelligence," Giorgi said. "The market's just not giving the benefit of the doubt to companies that are spending a ton of money on building this all out, which to us is actually very healthy, but still does augur for some short-term pain." Investors also have their focus trained on the US midterm elections on November 3, with growing bets that the Democrats will wrest control of the US Congress away from President Donald Trump's Republican party. The series of market catalysts could ratchet up volatility over the next couple of weeks and challenge optimism that has helped lift the benchmark S&P 500 index up about 12 per cent in 2026. HYPERSCALERS ON THE HOT SEAT Robust US profit growth has underpinned the stock market's gains this year in the face of headwinds including spiking Treasury yields and rising energy costs stemming from the Middle East conflict. With more than 100 companies having posted results so far, third-quarter S&P 500 earnings are on pace to have climbed more than 32 per cent from a year ago, according to LSEG IBES data. Next week is the busiest of the reporting season. "I think earnings will determine whether this ... tech pullback is a buying opportunity, or is there a deeper correction ahead," said King Lip, chief strategist at BakerAvenue Wealth Management. "What we need is just another round of really strong earnings." Alphabet and Microsoft report on Wednesday. Amazon's results are due Thursday. Focus will be on the guidance the companies give on capital spending plans and whether they are seeing returns on the massive outlays. Capital spending from hyperscalers, expected to be around $800 billion this year, is boosting the bottom lines for a wide swath of companies involved in the AI buildout. But investors are wary of the sustainability of such spending amid mounting financing costs. "Earnings are critical to the overall confidence level of the AI trade and how much longer the spend will continue," said Kevin Mahn, president and chief investment officer at Hennion & Walsh Asset Management. FED EXPECTED TO PAUSE ON RATES, FOR NOW Quarterly reports next week from chip companies Intel and Sandisk also could influence the AI trade. Elsewhere, other high-profile companies set to report next week include drugmaker Eli Lilly, oil majors Exxon and Chevron and industrial equipment giant Caterpillar.  The prospect for more interest rate hikes also comes into focus with the Fed meeting. The Fed raised rates in September for the first time since 2023, in an effort to control above-target inflation, but Fed fund futures late on Thursday suggested only a 5 per cent chance the Fed will hike again when it gives its policy statement on Wednesday, according to LSEG data.  One factor: Investors are dubious that the Fed will want to increase rates just a week before the midterm elections. However, markets are leaning toward a hike at the next meeting in December, with futures suggesting an 80 per cent probability of such a move then. Walter Todd, chief investment officer at Greenwood Capital, said he will be watching for any hints about the rate path at Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference following the decision.  "Does he say something to give an idea about December, because right now the expectation is there is going to be a hike?" Todd said.

Source: Reuters

item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Private plaintiffs' lawyers stand to collect up to $1.27 billion from New Mexico if the state's $25 billion court win against Meta Platforms this week is upheld, according to a Reuters review of a contract with the state. New Mexico hired Chicago-based law firm DiCello Levitt to represe

Exclusive-New Mexico's outside lawyers could collect up to $1.27 billion in Meta case

FILE PHOTO: Meta's logo and a keyboard are shown in this illustration created on October 19, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Private plaintiffs' lawyers stand to collect up to $1.27 billion from New Mexico if the state's $25 billion court win against Meta Platforms this week is upheld, according to a Reuters review of a contract with the state.  New Mexico hired Chicago-based law firm DiCello Levitt to represent it in the Meta case, which alleged the tech company duped its users about who had access to their personal data on its Facebook platform. The state's 2025 contract with DiCello Levitt, reviewed by Reuters after a records request, says the firm can ask the judge overseeing the case to award it 20 per cent of the first $50 million of any eventual recovery, 15 per cent of the next $50 million, 10 per cent of the next $150 million and 5 per cent of any amounts over $250 million.  New Mexico and other states have turned to private law firms in a growing number of cases against major technology companies to buttress their legal teams against deep-pocketed defendants. The outside lawyers typically don't charge by the hour but are entitled to a cut of any winnings.

In the Meta case, a jury sided with the state in September, and a judge on Wednesday ordered the company to pay $25 billion. Meta denied wrongdoing and said it will appeal. Legal experts including Villanova University law professor Peter Ormerod told Reuters this week that the company has a strong basis for arguing that the judgment should be reduced.  If New Mexico ultimately recovers $25 billion from Meta, DiCello Levitt's fees could reach $1.27 billion under the law firm's contract. The amount would come out of the funds Meta pays to New Mexico.    UNCERTAINTY OVER FINAL PAYOUT To be sure, Meta could win its appeal or the judgment could be trimmed, and the court is not obligated to award the firm the maximum fees allowed under its contract. DiCello Levitt declined to comment about its fees. New Mexico's lead lawyer at the firm, Corban Rhodes, in a statement called the court's decision a "defining moment for consumer protection and privacy." Randi McGinn, a New Mexico lawyer who worked with the DiCello firm in representing the state, told Reuters her small Albuquerque firm is entitled to collect about 33 per cent of its fees. DiCello's contract allowed the firm to designate other lawyers as subcontractors. McGinn, who delivered the state's opening statement and closing argument, cautioned that a final outcome in the case could take several years. “People will say it’s a lot of money. But the truth is, we won’t see any of that money unless we win an appeal,” McGinn said.  Contingency fee awards over $1 billion are exceedingly rare, said Fordham University law professor Howard Erichson. While New Mexico's contract caps fees for DiCello Levitt near 5 per cent, "the sheer size of the recovery means it could result in a massive fee here, so I would expect the court to examine it carefully," Erichson said. The New Mexico attorney general's office and a Meta spokesperson did not immediately respond to requests for comment about the legal fees. STATES TURN TO PRIVATE FIRMS Some companies and business groups say that giving private lawyers a stake in state enforcement actions can put lawyers' financial interests in conflict with public policy concerns. Defenders of the practice counter that it helps level the playing field for states going up against companies that can afford armies of lawyers.  The rewards can be substantial. Norton Rose Fulbright is set to receive more than $156 million in legal fees for representing Texas in a consumer privacy case that Google settled for $1.375 billion. Law firms Keller Postman and McKool Smith billed Texas $142.6 million in a consumer privacy lawsuit against Meta that led to a $1.4 billion settlement in 2024. DiCello Levitt's contract mirrors one between New Mexico and Motley Rice for a separate lawsuit alleging Meta fostered social media addiction and other harms on its platforms. Meta denies the claims. Motley Rice could seek up to $67.1 million in that case if appeals courts uphold a pair of rulings totaling $942 million against Meta. Wednesday’s ruling came in a case New Mexico filed in 2021 against Meta after disclosures that British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica obtained data from as many as 87 million Facebook users without their consent. The now-defunct Cambridge Analytica used the data for voter profiling and targeting.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Republican 'Muslim Brotherhood' attacks on El-Sayed in Michigan seek to exploit Democratic fault lines
item.description: In Michigan, Republican US Senate candidate Mike Rogers and allies are escalating their efforts to tie Democratic rival Abdul El-Sayed to the Muslim Brotherhood, with President Donald Trump falsely branding him a "jihadist."
item.dc:creator: David Morgan
item.content:encoded: Republican US Senate candidate Mike Rogers and allies including President Donald Trump are escalating their efforts to tie Democratic rival Abdul El-Sayed to the Muslim Brotherhood less than two weeks before the [USN:L1N4600TJ TEXT:"November 3 midterms"], with Trump falsely branding him a "jihadist." Pollsters and political strategists say the approach is aimed at dissuading Jewish and Black voters in the Detroit area who backed El-Sayed's primary opponent, Haley Stevens, from getting behind the Democratic nominee in the closing days of the Senate campaign in Michigan. "It gives them even more reason to pause and not vote for El-Sayed," said Dennis Darnoi, a Republican political consultant. "If Democratic voters aren't casting ballots for El-Sayed in what is the biggest population area here, then that is a net benefit to Mike Rogers' campaign." El-Sayed and Rogers are vying for the seat held by retiring Democratic Senator Gary Peters in a race that could determine whether Democrats gain the four Senate seats needed to take control of the chamber in next month's election. Republicans currently have a 53-47 seat majority, which would be harder to overturn if El-Sayed loses. The Democrat has built a small lead in opinion polls by focusing his campaign on affordability, healthcare and getting money out of politics. Rogers has sought to undermine the Democrat's support among Jewish voters by pointing to El-Sayed's criticism of Israel's offensive in Gaza and asserting that El-Sayed has longstanding family ties to the Muslim Brotherhood, one of the Arab world's oldest and most influential Islamist groups. Strategists said homing in on the Muslim Brotherhood also aims to hurt El-Sayed by exploiting economic tensions between Black voters and Michigan's large Arab-American community. Rogers has pointed to old social media posts by El-Sayed's half sister saying their mother was involved with the organization in the 1970s. El-Sayed has disavowed the Muslim Brotherhood, denied any connection with the group and has said that he was not raised by his mother. His parents divorced when he was 3 years old, and he was raised by his father and step-mother. Asked about Rogers' strategy, campaign spokesperson Alyssa Brouillet said El-Sayed's "extremist positions" on issues ranging from prisons to the Muslim Brotherhood were alienating Michiganders. El-Sayed campaign spokesperson Roxie Richner said Rogers is trying to distract from the economic effects of Trump's agenda, adding in a statement: "Independent fact checkers have repeatedly debunked Mike’s lies, but their campaign continues to use bad faith attacks on Abdul's faith and family." 'PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN' Rogers hit the Muslim Brotherhood message hard during this week's televised debate, questioning the Democrat's loyalty to the US. "If you are going to go to the United States Senate, we need to know: are you for America or are you for these terrorist groups overseas?" Rogers asked. El-Sayed, a son of Egyptian immigrants who would be the first Muslim to be elected to the US Senate if he wins, responded by calling the question shameful. "It's actually quite beneath you, Mike," he replied. "I am proud of America. I'm proud to be an American. I'm proud of our Constitution that guarantees all of us the right to pray as we choose to pray." Rogers, a former congressman, US Army officer and FBI agent, later appealed directly to Democrats who voted for Stevens, saying they "have a home" with him if they were worried that El-Sayed was too "extreme." MICHIGAN SENATE RACE A 'TOSS-UP' It is unclear if the Republican strategy is paying off. The race is rated a toss-up by independent political analysts, with polls showing El-Sayed with an average lead of 2.6 percentage points, according to the website RealClearPolling.com. El-Sayed has campaigned recently with prominent Black political figures such as Senator Raphael Warnock of Georgia, Representative Ayanna Pressley of Massachusetts and 2024 Democratic presidential candidate Kamala Harris. Former President Barack Obama, who has endorsed El-Sayed, is due to campaign with him on Saturday. Michigan Democratic Party Black Caucus Chair Keith Williams, who backed Stevens in Michigan's Democratic primary contest and is now working to rally support for El-Sayed, acknowledged that tensions between the Black and Arab American communities are an issue for the candidate. "We have to work through our differences," Williams told Reuters. "At the end of the day, this election is bigger than our differences because we cannot have a senator going to Washington and supporting Donald Trump's policies." Some strategists say the attacks may have come too late to reshape the race and risk backfiring if voters view them as anti-Muslim. "I don't know what this does for them," said Jim Zogby, a longtime pollster and co-founder of the Arab American Institute, a nonprofit that advocates for the Arab American community. "There are people who think Haitians eat cats and dogs and think anybody with an Arabic name is either a terrorist or a member of the Muslim Brotherhood. But that's a much smaller group of people - and it's already a Republican group of people." OVERWHELMING SUPPORT FROM BLACK VOTERS A September Emerson College poll showed support for El-Sayed at 81% among Black voters, who make up about a quarter of Michigan Democrats. "There was no sign there in mid-September of erosion of Black support for El-Sayed. I would not suspect that the number would have changed much over the last month," said Matt Taglia, senior director of Emerson College Polling. Democrat Jocelyn Benson, who is running for Michigan governor, scored 4 percentage points higher in the same poll, while Harris drew 86% of the Black vote in 2024. Michigan pollster Steve Mitchell said weaker support among Black and Jewish voters could cost El-Sayed as many as 20,000 votes. Rogers lost his 2024 Senate bid to Democrat Elissa Slotkin by a similar margin.

FAST

Oct 23 : MotoGP will forge ahead with next month's Qatar Grand Prix despite Middle East tensions and concerns from some riders over safety, while others said they trusted organisers Dorna to ensure the race could be staged safely. The race at the Lusail International Circuit, originally scheduled for April but postponed to November 6-8 due to the regional conflict, remains on the calendar for what would be the 20th round of the season. Several sports events in Saudi Arabia, including the Saudi International golf tournament, the Urban Cycling World Championships and the FIFAe World Cup, were scrapped earlier this month after a strike on Riyadh's international airport killed at least 12 people and wounded more than 300. Earlier this week, the US State Department ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and plans to withdraw family members from a number of other US missions in the region.

However, a MotoGP source told Reuters the Qatar Grand Prix remains on the calendar and preparations continue, adding that the safety and wellbeing of everyone involved was their first priority. ALEX MARQUEZ VOICES SCEPTICISM Gresini Racing's Alex Marquez, who finished runner-up in the championship last season, voiced scepticism about whether safety could truly be guaranteed in such a volatile environment. "Every day, it (the situation) changes and every day it looks worse. That's how it is," the Spaniard said ahead of this weekend's Australian Grand Prix. "The championship tells us that everything is under control, but I think nobody has a situation like that under control. It's quite complex. "From one day to the next, everything can change a lot, and I think it's not a decision they should make now. They should be realistic and wait for the next few days." Formula One is also planning to host the season's last two races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi as planned, with International Automobile Federation (FIA) president Mohammed Ben Sulayem saying the situation was currently "fine" in the region. Liberty Media, which acquired the F1 commercial rights in 2017, took over MotoGP's parent company Dorna in 2024. "For sure it is a lot of money on the deal and Dorna wants everything. It's like that," Marquez added. "But also with the health of everybody they need to take care as well, because many people will go there." CHAMPIONSHIP LEADER MARTIN KEEN TO RACE While the Formula One championship could be wrapped up before the final two races of the season - with Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli holding a 102-point lead - the MotoGP title race remains razor-tight after 17 of the 22 rounds. Aprilia's Jorge Martin holds a two-point lead over Ducati's reigning champion Marc Marquez ahead of this weekend's action at the Phillip Island Circuit. "I want to go to Qatar because the circuit is incredible. I believe in the championship and in what those who manage it decide," Martin said. "Nobody has said we're not going. It's just another race. If we go, great. If not, that's fine too. If the organisers decide we can go, it'll be because our safety is guaranteed." The Qatar Grand Prix has been a near-constant fixture on the MotoGP calendar since its debut in 2004, with the only interruption coming in 2020 when the race was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source: Reuters

item.title: New 'Scentronic' technology can detect and transmit aromas remotely
item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : People can readily share images and sounds digitally, as evidenced by the billions of smartphones in use globally that often overload the human senses of sight and hearing. But smell generally remains missing from remote communication. That could soon change.Researchers have developed tec

New 'Scentronic' technology can detect and transmit aromas remotely

Ohio State University researcher Chunyu Yang wears a prototype odor generator device which is part of a technology called Scentronic that can detect scents and transmit them remotely, at Columbus, Ohio, on June 13, 2025, in this image released October 21, 2026. Shaoru Cheng/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : People can readily share images and sounds digitally, as evidenced by the billions of smartphones in use globally that often overload the human senses of sight and hearing. But smell generally remains missing from remote communication. That could soon change. Researchers have developed technology that features an electronic nose that recognizes certain smells, like the distinctive aroma of coffee, and then instructs a small and wearable remote device to release scent molecules matching it. The digital communication can take place at any distance, from across the room to around the world. "In simple terms, it connects 'smelling something here' with 'recreating the corresponding smell somewhere else,'" said Chunyu Yang, an Ohio State University doctoral student in materials science and engineering and lead author of a study describing the technology published in the journal Science Advances. "The idea is to add smell to the visual and audio information we already share remotely, making those experiences more engaging," Yang said.

The researchers call this latest development in the field of digital scent technology "Scentronic." "What makes Scentronic different is that it brings odor sensing and generation together for remote sharing. To the best of our knowledge, our study is the first to explore this integration in a compact platform for remote odor sharing," Yang said. The researchers created an e-nose, a device that uses an array of gas sensors to detect chemical compounds associated with different odors. A machine-learning model then classifies odors that the e-nose has been trained to recognize — beer, cake, coffee, oranges and red wine. The technology uses an online platform to transmit the odor information to a scent generator, which then releases fragrances to recreate the aroma at the receiving end. The scent molecules themselves are not transmitted over the internet. The e-nose device is roughly 6 inches (15 cm) in diameter and is portable, though not designed to be worn. The researchers developed several versions of the odor generator, including wristband, necklace and handheld designs. 'EVERYDAY ODORS' At this point, the e-nose recognizes just the five scents. "We chose these because they are familiar everyday odors with different scent profiles, making them useful examples for demonstrating the system. We have not yet expanded beyond those categories," Yang said. "A broader scent library is possible in principle, but an unlimited repertoire is far beyond what we have demonstrated. Recognizing an odor and accurately reproducing it are separate challenges. Covering a useful range of everyday scents is a more realistic goal, although that would still require substantial development," Yang said. The receiving device cannot recreate every smell Scentronic encounters.  "To support additional odors, we would need to train the electronic nose to recognize them and provide corresponding scented liquids in the odor generator," Yang said. The researchers see various potential applications for the technology. "For example, someone could share the scent of a meal with family or friends who live far away. Other potential applications include more immersive virtual and augmented reality experiences and online shopping that allows customers to sample selected scents remotely," Yang said. 'A RESEARCH PROTOTYPE' The research was conducted and the devices developed without the involvement of a company, Yang said. "At present, this is a research prototype. Moving toward commercialization would require a larger, more diverse training dataset and reliable odor recognition under real-world conditions, where smells often occur in mixtures," Yang said. "The odor generator would also need further development to support more scents while remaining compact and convenient to use. Other considerations include scent fidelity, refillability, durability, manufacturing costs and the safety of repeated exposure to the scented mist," Yang said. Smartphones are becoming increasingly capable. Could they in the future incorporate scent technology so that, for instance, a person at a tailgate party before an Ohio State football game could call a friend and share video, audio and the aroma of hot dogs on the grill? "In principle, a smartphone could connect to a scent-generating accessory. Integrating everything into the phone itself would be more challenging because the scent reservoirs, electronics and atomizers all take up space and add weight. Miniaturization and convenient refilling would be important considerations," Yang said. "The tailgate example illustrates the idea well. A future system could potentially combine video and audio with a corresponding scent, provided it could recognize the relevant odor and the receiver had a suitable scent formulation available. Our current system has not demonstrated the transmission of a grilling-hot-dog scent or the exact mixture of smells at a tailgate party," Yang said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, cyber experts say
item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Advances in artificial intelligence have uncovered a stream of new software vulnerabilities that are almost certain to trigger more disruption along the lines of the outages that percolated across global government websites this week, according to seven cybersecurity professionals who spoke to R

AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, cyber experts say

The words "AI Cyberattack" and PHP code are displayed on a screen in this illustration taken on October 22, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : Advances in artificial intelligence have uncovered a stream of new software vulnerabilities that are almost certain to trigger more disruption along the lines of the outages that percolated across global government websites this week, according to seven cybersecurity professionals who spoke to Reuters. AI helped drive a doubling of the number of digital flaws discovered year-on-year, according to research due to be published in the coming days by VulnCheck, a Massachusetts-based threat intelligence firm. Matthew Prince, the chief executive of the digital infrastructure firm Cloudflare, told Reuters he was aware of “a bunch of additional severe vulnerabilities that are present in other pieces of critical software” and predicted busy months ahead as AI surfaced long-hidden weaknesses in the fabric of the internet.   “I think we’re going to have a couple years where every single week it’s going to feel like the sky is falling,” Prince said in an interview on Thursday.

The outages that spread across government sites in Europe and elsewhere beginning on Wednesday happened after the discovery of weaknesses in PHP, a venerable programming language that powers a huge swath of the internet. Operators have been rushing to fix their software in anticipation of mass exploitation and, because some felt they could not patch before hackers jumped in, a subset simply yanked their sites offline until they could make them safe. VulnCheck researcher Patrick Garrity said the scramble to fix PHP came during an already busy week in cybersecurity. The week also brought disclosures of vulnerabilities PHP alternative Node.js and streaming program Plex, breaches tied to AI gateway LiteLLM and development platform Railway, and the revelation that the Indian certificate authority eMudhra had used an extraordinarily flimsy cryptographic key that potentially put users across the internet at risk. “If we just saw four or five things like this, this week, I would expect we’re going to see a lot more,” Garrity said. “I think there’s going to be a lot more fire drills for anything that’s internet exposed.” TIMELINES SHORTENING  The codebases that run modern programs are sprawling and mistakes, or “bugs,” that open up potential avenues for exploitation often crop up in unexpected places.  Previously, finding bugs required a baseline level of skill, and taking advantage of those bugs to build digital lockpicks – called “exploits” – could be expected to take weeks or months of work by an experienced professional. That would in the past have provided defenders a little breathing room to fix bugs and gently roll out software updates. AI has effectively thrown those assumptions out the window. Models can find one bug after another by subjecting codebases to round-the-clock scrutiny, and can turn around exploits in hours. Shane Fry, the chief technology officer of Virginia-based RunSafe Security, said the demonstrated performance of AI models over the past few months had effectively laid to rest any doubts over whether they would change the industry. “What's fundamentally, and unquestionably, changing is the timescale for not only finding vulnerabilities, but how quickly adversaries can weaponize them,” Fry said.  SCARY MONSTERS While all the experts Reuters spoke to agreed that defenders’ timelines were getting shorter, they were split on whether AI would lead to a hacker free-for-all. Daniel Stenberg, the lead developer of the file transfer tool curl, argued the vulnerabilities found by AI models tended to be exotic bugs that were difficult for rogue actors to take advantage of. Ramy Rahman, a senior principal solutions engineer at cybersecurity company ArmorCode, said “more disclosed vulnerabilities do not automatically mean more successful attacks." There was tentative evidence of that around the PHP vulnerability that drew worldwide concern this week. Threat intelligence firm Hunt.io said that – like Amazon and Cloudflare – it had seen aggressive attempts to take advantage of the bug. But the firm’s head of research, Esteban Borges, said that, as of 2 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday (1800 GMT), the cybercriminals he tracked appeared to have failed to cobble together a working tool to take advantage of it. Prince, of Cloudflare, told Reuters he had seen anecdotal evidence of compromises linked to the PHP vulnerability.  The deluge of AI-driven discoveries might rattle the industry, but would be a net positive in the end, he said, comparing it to slaying the monsters in a haunted house. The confrontation might be scary, he said, but leaving the monsters to lurk quietly behind closed doors was far worse.  “The reality is, we’re going to get a lot of this stuff cleaned up,” he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 印通信ジオＩＰＯ、機関投資家応募26.5倍 評価最大1083億ドル
item.description:
Aditya Kalra
[ニューデリー ２３日 ロイター] - インド大手財閥リライアンス傘下の通信会社ジオ・プラ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
印通信ジオＩＰＯ、機関投資家応募26.5倍　評価最大1083億ドル 18:57 配信

ジオの広告が並んだ道路。2026年10月21日、インドのムンバイで撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

Aditya Kalra

[ニューデリー ２３日 ロイター] - インド大手財閥リライアンス傘下の通信会社ジオ・プラットフォームズの３２億ドル規模の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は、申し込み最終日の２３日、 応募がさらに膨らみ、募集枠の１０倍を超えた。評価額は最大１０８３億ドル。２８日に取引が始まれば、時価総額でインド最大級の企業の一つとなる可能性がある。

ジオのＩＰＯは、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への視線が厳しさを増す中、大型上場に対する投資家の意欲を測る試金石として注目されている。ＩＰＯはヒンズー教の縁起の良い祝祭シーズンに合わせて実施される。

機関投資家、個人投資家、従業員、株主から旺盛な需要があった。大半の申し込みが価格帯の上限である１株＝１１１９ルピーで行われたと仮定すると、需要総額は既に２４５億ドルを超えている。

これとは別に、アブダビ投資庁（ＡＤＩＡ）や米ブラックロック、フィデリティなどのいわゆるアンカー投資家が１９日、専用の割当枠に応募している。８億５４００万ドル相当の割当枠に対し、２５０億ドルを超える申し込みがあった。

取引所のデータによると、２３日時点で機関投資家向け枠の応募倍率は２６．５倍に達し、大口投資家の旺盛な需要が浮き彫りとなった。個人投資家向け枠は２．３倍、従業員枠とリライアンス既存株主枠はそれぞれ２．７倍、６．６倍だった。

ジオはリライアンス・インダストリーズの傘下にあり、携帯通信網の利用者は５億人を超える。これは単一国内の顧客数ベースで中国移動（チャイナモバイル）に次ぐ規模だ。

item.title: シティ、中国で証券事業の完全子会社設立許可を取得
item.description: [北京／香港 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国の証券監督当局は２３日、米金融大手シティが中国で１００％出資の証券子会社を設...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シティ、中国で証券事業の完全子会社設立許可を取得 18:49 配信

米金融大手シティのロゴ。2025年12月1日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

[北京／香港 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国の証券監督当局は２３日、米金融大手シティが中国で１００％出資の証券子会社を設立する計画を承認したと発表した。

上海に本社を置く「シティグループ・セキュリティーズ・チャイナ・カンパニー」は、引受、株式仲介、国内証券取引、証券リサーチ、投資助言など、国内外の顧客向けにオンショア資本市場サービスを提供することが認められた。

中国で法人・機関投資家向けバンキングサービスなどを提供しているシティは、オンショア事業拡大の一環として、２０２１年終盤に中国本土における証券事業の完全子会社ライセンスを申請していた。

グループ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）のジェーン・フレイザー氏は声明で「われわれのグローバルプラットフォームにオンショア機能を追加することで、中国の国内資本市場における顧客に対し、資金調達、投資家へのアクセス、現地取引の支援に加え、世界中の投資機会への接続など、より幅広いサービスを提供できるようになる」と述べた。

item.title: Gunman fires from car near Paris, killing 1; police arrest suspect
item.description: The shooting comes at a moment of particular tension in France, after nationwide protests turned violent last Saturday and ahead of possible unrest this coming weekend.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A gunman opened fire from a car outside Paris, killing one person and wounding four others including a 12-year-old girl on Friday, French authorities said. "We would like to thank our law enforcement agencies, which have already taken the suspect into custody. The National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor's Office has taken over the case," President Emmanuel Macron said in a post on X, expressing deep sorrow over the killing. The shooting comes at a moment of particular tension in France, after nationwide protests [USN:L1N46908B TEXT:"turned violent"] last Saturday and ahead of possible unrest this coming weekend. Ali Rabeh, the mayor of the town of Trappes west of Paris, told BFMTV that a man had fired shoots from his car and "appeared to be firing at random and seemed intent on carrying out a massacre". Rabeh said the gunman was driving on a road from Trappes to neighbouring La Verriere and lived in a nearby town. Broadcaster BFM reported that the wounded 12-year-old girl had been hit eight times. The anti-terrorism prosecutor's office said its investigation included looking at whether the shooting was a terrorist act or if it were racially or religiously motivated.

item.title: 中小企業のサイバーセキュリティー強化を、自民対処本部が経産相に要請
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 自民党「国家サイバーセキュリティ戦略本部」の平将明本部長（元デジタル相）は２３日、都内で赤沢亮正経済産業相と会談し、相次ぐサイバー攻撃と個人情報の流出事案を受けとりまとめた提言を申し入れた。大企業だけでなく、中小企業も含めてサイバー対処能力強化に取り組むよう要請した。

平氏は、政府や自衛隊、在日米軍、基幹インフラ事業者は手厚く守る体制がある一方「今攻撃されているのはそれ以外の大企業で、さらに中堅・中小企業もある」と指摘。ＩｏＴ（モノのインターネット）端末の評価や供給網全体の強靭性増強などの提言内容を紹介した。

赤沢氏は「大変、事が深刻化して国民が不安になった途端に迅速に取りまとめていただき心強い」と応じた。「オフ・ホワイトハッカー」によるチームを来月中に独立行政法人・情報処理推進機構（ＩＰＡ）に立ち上げる方針を説明し「発想を変えて、防御というよりはもう攻撃の視点で企業の弱点を洗い出して、徹底的に強化していこうという思いがある」と述べた。

item.title: Volkswagen-Les salariés menacent de faire grève si les accords ne sont pas respectés
item.description: Les dirigeants syndicaux allemands ont menacé d'organiser des grèves chez Volkswagen à partir de janvier, si l'entreprise ne revient pas d'ici fin octobre sur sa récente annulation des accords salariaux, marquant ainsi une escalade des conflits sociaux au sein du groupe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les dirigeants syndicaux allemands ont menacé d'organiser des grèves chez Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) à partir de janvier, si l'entreprise ne revient pas d'ici fin octobre sur sa récente annulation des accords salariaux, marquant ainsi une escalade des conflits sociaux au sein du groupe. "Nous donnons à l'entreprise jusqu'à la fin du mois d'octobre pour retirer cet avis de résiliation", a déclaré Thorsten Groeger, du syndicat IG Metall, lors d'une conférence de presse. "Sinon, un processus de grande ampleur sera enclenché qui, je tiens à le préciser, ouvrira la voie à des actions collectives chez Volkswagen", a-t-il ajouté, suggérant des grèves. Une trêve excluant toute grève au sein de l’entreprise expire le 1er janvier 2027. Le premier constructeur automobile européen prévoit de [USN:L6N43F0NW TEXT:"supprimer"] 100.000 emplois et pourrait fermer jusqu’à quatre usines en Allemagne, alors qu’il est confronté à une concurrence chinoise de plus en plus intense, à des milliards de coûts liés aux droits de douane et à une transition coûteuse vers les véhicules électriques. Le conflit avec les délégués du personnel au sujet des réductions prévues a atteint son paroxysme le mois dernier, lorsque Volkswagen a résilié la quasi-totalité des accords salariaux conclus avec ses salariés allemands, remettant ainsi sur la table des négociations des normes de travail établies de longue date, notamment en matière de temps de travail et d’indemnités de congés payés. Le syndicat accuse le constructeur de se soustraire aux engagements pris dans le cadre d’un accord historique conclu fin 2024, tandis que Volkswagen affirme explorer toutes les options possibles pour réduire les coûts et préserver sa compétitivité. Le comité d'entreprise a déclaré lundi que son directoire prévoyait de geler les salaires de 660.000 salariés à travers le monde jusqu'en 2030. "Nous savons quelles conditions d'exploitation ont changé, mais nous savons aussi lesquelles étaient prévisibles, et nous attendons du directoire le mieux rémunéré de ce pays qu'il travaille avec nous pour trouver une solution", a commenté la présidente du comité d'entreprise, Daniela Cavallo. Le groupe a refusé de s'exprimer sur les mesures spécifiques de réduction des coûts et de restructuration qu'elle pourrait mettre en œuvre dans le cadre des négociations salariales allemandes, qui doivent débuter au plus tard début décembre, Thorsten Groeger ayant appelé à ce qu'elles commencent dès le 24 novembre. Une option pourrait être la création d'une "société de transfert", mise en place avec le soutien de l'Agence fédérale pour l'emploi afin de reconvertir les salariés et de les aider à trouver un nouvel emploi en dehors de Volkswagen.

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株後場切り返す、「国家隊」下支え観測 週間で最長下落
item.description: [上海 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。前場は軟調だったが、政府系投資家が好んで売買する上場投資信託（ＥＴ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株後場切り返す、「国家隊」下支え観測　週間で最長下落 18:20 配信

[上海 ２３日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は反発。前場は軟調だったが、政府系投資家が好んで売買する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の取引が急増し、後場に切り返した。

優良株で構成するＣＳＩ３００指数は一時１．９％下落したが、１．７％高で終了。上海総合指数が０．９％高。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は６月２２日の終値ベースの高値を約１９％下回っており、テクニカル的な弱気相場入りの目安とされる２０％下落に近づいている。週間では１．６％下落。１１週連続の下落で２００５年の指数算出開始以来、最長となった。

後場の反転の背景には、政府系投資家で構成する「国家隊」に人気のＥＴＦ数銘柄の売買急増がある。これを受け、当局が相場を下支えしているとの観測が広がった。

トレーダーやアナリストは、最近の中国本土株（Ａ株）の軟調さは、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策に対する失望が影響していると指摘する。

モルガン・スタンレーのアナリストは中国株に引き続き慎重な姿勢を示し、「内需の弱さと流動性面の逆風が続いている。一方、バリュエーション（株価評価）はまだ明確な底に達していない」と述べた。

ＲＢＣウェルス・マネジメントはリポートで、財政刺激策の不足と期待外れの企業業績が株価下落の原因と指摘。新たな政策や技術面の材料がなければ、不安定な相場は来年初めまで続く可能性があり、国家隊の下支えだけでは、相場回復を維持できないとの見方を示した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が０．７％高で引けた。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＶＷに賃金協約破棄撤回要求、独労組　応じなければ来年スト 18:18 配信

独自動車大手フォルクスワーゲンの車。7月9日、ドイツのボルフスブルクで撮影。 REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

［フランクフルト　２３日　ロイター］ - ドイツの主要労働組合幹部は２３日、自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）が賃金協約の破棄を１０月末までに撤回しなければ、２０２７年１月からストライキを実施すると警告した。

ＩＧメタル（金属産業労組）のトーステン・グレーガー代表は会見で、「ＶＷに対し、１０月末を破棄撤回期限としている」とし、「撤回されない場合、ＶＷでの争議行為に道を開くことになる」と述べた。労組のストライキ自粛期間は２７年１月１日に終了する。

ＶＷのオリバー・ブルーメ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は同社として史上、最も大胆な事業再編を進めており、労使関係はここ数か月で一段と悪化している。

item.title: India plans jobs survey changes to add unpaid work, improve gig worker data
item.description: India has proposed changes to its employment survey to better capture digital platform gig and unpaid work, the statistics ministry said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Shubham Batra, Manoj Kumar
item.content:encoded: India has proposed changes to its employment survey to better capture digital platform gig and unpaid work, the statistics ministry said on Friday. The revisions come amid a [USN:L1N3TJ071 TEXT:"debate"] over whether the official jobs data reflects underemployment and the quality of jobs in the world's most populous country, where the headline unemployment (INUNR=ECI) stands at 5%. While changes to the Periodic Labour Force Survey will affect comparisons with past data, India is aiming to tweak how it defines and measures employment while expanding the ambit of the survey. The survey will add a separate category for digital platform workers as the existing method did not capture enough of them, the ministry said. As part of this, it will ask a wider set of respondents across rural and urban households if members are engaged in digital platform work. India has seen a 55% increase in gig workers in the five years to 2025-26, the government's economic survey said in January, estimating that such workers may make up 2% of the total workforce in the country. MEASURING UNPAID WORK The changes proposed to the jobs survey will also measure activities that are usually not paid for, including production of goods for own use, household and caregiving activities, volunteer and unpaid trainee work. "This initiative to estimate platform gig workers is a half-step as there are a large number of informal gig workers who are not on any platform," said K.R. Shyam Sundar, a labour economist and a former professor at XLRI Jamshedpur. "However, capturing unpaid work in the PLFS survey is an important step ... and could eventually lead to changes in the methodology used to calculate national income as well." The changes will kick in from January 2027, with fresh samples for 2027-28. The government has invited public and expert feedback on the proposals within 15 days.

item.title: 英総合ＰＭＩ、10月は53.1に上昇 2月以来の高水準
item.description: [ロンドン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめた１０月の英総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５３．１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英総合ＰＭＩ、10月は53.1に上昇　2月以来の高水準 18:16 配信

[ロンドン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめた１０月の英総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５３．１と、 ９月の５２．０から上昇した。新規受注の増加や堅調なＡＩ（人工知能）関連需要を背景に２月以来の高水準となった。

ロイターが調査したエコノミスト予想も全て上回った。ＰＭＩは５０を上回れば景況拡大を、下回れば悪化を示す。

企業は、リーブス財務相（当時）の２０２４年予算案による増税で雇用が打撃を受けて以来初めて、追加の従業員を採用。雇用市場の回復を示すさらなる兆候となった。

製造業の生産は２年余りで最大の伸びを記録。サービス業では新規受注の増加ペースが加速した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルによると、一部企業はＡＩへの投資支出やテクノロジーサービスへの需要増加に伴い売り上げが拡大したと報告した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフビジネスエコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は、その他の企業は来週の予算案発表を前に支出を控えていたと指摘。ヒーリー財務相が企業に打撃を与える措置を回避すれば、近いうちにさらなる成長が見込める可能性があると述べた。

物価上昇圧力は依然として強く、「イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が次回の政策決定会合で利上げを行うことはほぼ確実であるだけでなく、２７年にかけてさらなる利上げが行われる可能性も高まっている」とした。

企業のコストインフレは６月以来の高水準となり、特に製造業で顕著だったが、販売価格の上昇幅は９月ほど急激ではなかった。

企業の今後１年間の見通しはわずかに上向いたものの、ウクライナや湾岸での戦争、および借入コストの上昇を懸念する企業が多く、依然として長期平均を下回っている。

item.title: Weight-loss drugs fuel protein boom, but with more consumer scrutiny
item.description: Even as consumers seek out new sources of protein for their diets, they are becoming more skeptical of foods advertised as high-protein.
item.dc:creator: Waylon Cunningham, Nicholas Brown
item.content:encoded: Protein-infused bottled water. Ice cream. Boxed macaroni and cheese. Even vodka. The rise of weight-loss drugs is driving a boom in protein-based products, as users of GLP-1 medication like Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Ozempic and Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) Mounjaro look for ways to counter the muscle loss those drugs can cause. GLP-1 users say they will spend 11% more on high-protein foods than before starting the drugs, according to an August survey from Boston Consulting Group. This is the fifth story in a five-part Reuters series on how weight-loss drugs are changing the way people shop and eat, and how companies are responding to the trend. Even as consumers seek out new sources of protein for their diets, they are becoming more skeptical of foods advertised as high-protein, Reuters interviews with consumers and company executives found. Some shoppers question whether products contain as much protein as advertising implies, while blanching at those that pack in so many additives or sugar that they undercut the health pitch. A report from marketing research firm NielsenIQ earlier this year said the snack industry has entered its "accountability era," noting that 25% of its survey respondents this year said they are using scanning apps to check the nutritional value of products, up from around 17% last year. "Protein is no longer a differentiator," said Chris Costagli, a lead marketing researcher at NielsenIQ, who co-wrote the report. Megan Gisela Bautista, a nonprofit employee in Maryland who does strength training, was recently disappointed by the protein content of a chicken jerky snack that touted high protein in a large, colorful font. "I'd have to eat five of them," Bautista said. "That's bad for you." Zack Spears of Dallas said he is checking nutritional labels regularly, and now watches YouTube videos from an online content creator who reviews protein-marketed products. "As this protein craze pops off, and things are getting more expensive, I want to be sure what I'm putting in my body is healthy," Spears said. Some brands acknowledge the growing consumer scrutiny. “Protein is here to stay, but the conversation must evolve,” said Susan Zaripheh, North America chief research officer for yogurt maker Danone (DANO.PA) , in a statement to Reuters. “Consumers are starting to look ‘beyond the gram,’ becoming more informed in the nuances of protein source and nutrient density.” Over the summer, the French food company filed a false advertising [USN:L6N42P17H TEXT:"lawsuit"] against rival yogurt maker Chobani, accusing it of inflating its protein claims on labels by using non-standard serving sizes. Chobani has disputed those claims, telling Reuters in a statement that its labeling is accurate and transparent. Zaripheh said consumers want products that also aid in digestibility and contain other nutrients like fiber. In addition to existing high-protein yogurts and soy milks, the company is developing products that combine protein with other nutrients. Globe Market Research estimated over the summer that the worldwide protein-enriched food market was worth nearly $58 billion last year. But Hormel Foods (HRL.N) , well-known for protein-heavy products like Spam and canned lunch meats, said it is avoiding the use of additives to increase protein in its products. "We believe that in the long run, people don't want too much science in their food," said Jason Levine, Hormel chief marketing officer, referring to additives like "whey powder or pea powder or scientifically engineered protein isolates." SCRUTINIZING LABELS Reuters found several brands that advertise protein content based on a larger portion size than used in regular versions of the same product, including in pastas, oatmeals and granolas. Nature Valley, a snack brand owned by General Mills (GIS.N) , sells a version of its “oats ‘n honey” loose granola that advertises 13 grams of protein on its packaging, based on a 2/3 cup (65 grams) serving size, more than twice as big as the 1/4 cup (27 grams) it calls a serving size for its regular, non-enhanced granola. General Mills, in a statement, said it considers the regular version a snack while the protein version can be eaten either as a snack or a more complete cereal meal. The product's protein-to-calorie ratio, a metric dietitians use to describe a product's protein content, indicates a “very low amount of protein overall,” said Jonathan Bonnet, a Stanford professor and chief medical officer at the Ardmore Institute of Health, adding that a glass of skim milk has more protein than the 2/3-cup serving. Bonnet said more patients are asking him lately for guidance on their protein intake. Still, other companies are expanding their offerings to meet demand. Researcher Circana reported in August that around 48% of US adults are looking to add protein in their diets, up 7 points from last year. Discount supermarket chain Aldi recently told Reuters it is launching a new line of private-label protein pancakes in October, the latest in a string of high-protein items released this year that have included sparkling water, crackers and wagyu beef jerky. Walmart will start selling a new, protein-infused instant coffee product from J.M. Smucker's (SJM.N) Folgers from November until January exclusively, Walmart told Reuters last month. Some consumers and dietitians say the protein trend has led people to eat more protein than they need. NielsenIQ's report said a third of more than 1,000 surveyed respondents believe the food industry is overhyping protein — and another third believe some products have too much protein. Dana Hunnes, a professor and clinical dietitian at UCLA, says the average person doesn't need as much protein as industry marketing has promoted. And some protein-marketed products have too many processed ingredients to qualify as healthy, Hunnes said. “I’ve seen the equivalent of a candy bar” advertising protein, she said. “Just because it has protein doesn’t mean it’s something you should eat." Other stories in this series Beauty giants target 'Ozempic face' as boom in obesity drugs opens new market As weight-loss drug users turn to dietary supplements, doctors and regulators raise flags Ozempic wave boosts US cobblers and tailors as Americans tighten their belts Cherry or tabasco? Perfumers test weight-loss drug users' appetite for food-inspired scents

item.title: ユーロ圏総合ＰＭＩ、10月は4カ月ぶり低水準 仏の落ち込み響く
item.description:
Jonathan Cable
[ロンドン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが発表した１０月のユーロ圏総合購買担...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏総合ＰＭＩ、10月は4カ月ぶり低水準　仏の落ち込み響く 18:14 配信

2021年7月6日、ベルリンの街並み。REUTERS/Michele Tantussi

Jonathan Cable

[ロンドン ２３日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが発表した１０月のユーロ圏総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５１．９と、前月の５３．１から低下し、６月以来の低水準となった。エネルギー価格の上昇に伴うコスト増に加え、フランスの落ち込みが響いた。

ロイター調査では５２．７への小幅低下が予想されていた。ＰＭＩは５０を上回れば景況拡大を、下回れば悪化を示す。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスのロリー・フェネシー氏は「春から夏にかけてユーロ圏経済は予想を覆したものの、１０月の速報ＰＭＩはセンチメントが今後どれほど改善し得るかという点に若干の冷や水を浴びせる結果となった」と指摘。「フランスの不安定な情勢がユーロ圏全体に重くのしかかっており、財政状況の悪化に伴い、政府の借入コストはさらに上昇している」と述べた。

フランスの企業活動は予想外に縮小した。政治的な不確実性の高まりや経済的圧力に起因する財・サービス需要の落ち込みを反映している。

ドイツでも民間部門の成長は鈍化した。

英国のＰＭＩは堅調さを示し、企業活動は２月以来の高水準を記録した。

ただ、英国立統計局（ＯＮＳ）が発表した９月の小売売上高（数量ベース）は前月比０．４％減と、市場予想を上回る落ち込みとなった。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのチーフ・ビジネス・エコノミスト、クリス・ウィリアムソン氏は「全体の減速の主な要因は、今月インフレ圧力がさらに強まったことだ」と指摘した。「仕入れコストが再び急上昇している。製造業ではエネルギー価格の上昇を背景にコストの上昇率が急激に高まり、企業は利益率を守るため販売価格を引き上げている」と述べた。

仕入れコストの上昇は２カ月連続で加速した。エネルギーや燃料、輸送コストの上昇が背景にある。ただ企業の販売価格の引き上げペースは９月より鈍く、利益率がやや圧迫されていることがうかがえる。

ウィリアムソン氏は「金利上昇の影響も出始め、需要を抑えている。１０月のＰＭＩ速報値は、成長が続く一方でインフレが高止まりしている状況を示しており、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が一段と積極的に引き締めるとの観測を強める可能性が高い」と述べた。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのハリー・チェンバーズ氏は「製造業者はエネルギー価格の上昇による圧迫を引き続き感じているものの、二次的効果を示す証拠は依然としてほとんど見られず、これはＥＣＢにとって心強い材料となるだろう」と語った。

ユーロ圏の企業景況感は５カ月ぶりの低水準に落ち込んだ。特に製造業で楽観的な見方が大きく後退した。

財政面の圧力と政治の混乱に見舞われるフランスでは、悲観的な見方が際立った。同国のＰＭＩは経済活動の縮小を示し、企業景況感は新型コロナのパンデミック期を除くと２０１２年以来の低水準となった。

＜新規輸出受注は増加＞

新規受注は４カ月連続で増加したが、この間で最低となった。製造業、サービス業ともに小幅な伸びにとどまった。新規輸出受注は３カ月連続で増加。４年半近くにわたり毎月減少していた状況からの明るい兆しとなり、伸び率は新規受注全体を上回った。

サービス業ＰＭＩ速報値は５１．７と、９月の５３．０から低下し、２カ月ぶりの低水準となった。ロイター調査の予想は５２．５だった。総合ＰＭＩの算出に使われる製造業生産指数は５３．６から５２．４に低下し、４カ月ぶりの低水準となった。

製造業ＰＭＩは５２．９から５２．４に低下した。

雇用は過去２カ月の小幅増から、ほぼ横ばいとなった。サービス業の雇用の伸びは５カ月ぶりの低水準に鈍化し、製造業の雇用者数は２カ月間の増加を経て小幅に減少した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 アングル：欧州の中銀関係者、米国との協調維持に不安　市場介入に懸念 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 アングル：欧州の猛暑、経済損失は過去最大規模の恐れ　観光の変化で南欧に大打撃 アングル：欧州熱波、マクロ経済面からの市場注目ポイント 最終更新: 10/23(金) 19:11 ロイター

item.title: Erster russischer Diesel-Tanker auf dem Weg in die USA
item.description: Ein mit 40.000 Tonnen russischem Diesel beladener Tanker ist auf dem Weg nach New York. Dies ging am Freitag aus einer Reuters-Auswertung von Schifffahrtsdaten des Finanzdienstleisters LSEG hervor. Es handelt sich um die erste Lieferung dieser Art seit dem von der damaligen Regierung unter Präsident Joe Biden 2022 wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs verhängten Importverbot für russisches Öl und Ölprodukte. Sie ist Teil einer Vereinbarung zwischen US-Präsident Donald Trump und dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin. Trump hofft, mit mehreren Maßnahmen die Dieselpreise vor den US-Zwischenwahlen am 3. November zu senken. Dazu gehört auch die Aussetzung von Teilen eines neuen Sanktionsgesetzes gegen Russland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ein mit 40.000 Tonnen russischem Diesel beladener Tanker ist auf dem Weg nach New York. Dies ging am Freitag aus einer Reuters-Auswertung von Schifffahrtsdaten des Finanzdienstleisters LSEG hervor. Es handelt sich um die erste Lieferung dieser Art seit dem von der damaligen Regierung unter Präsident Joe Biden 2022 wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs verhängten Importverbot für russisches Öl und Ölprodukte. Sie ist Teil einer Vereinbarung zwischen US-Präsident Donald Trump und dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin. Trump hofft, mit mehreren Maßnahmen die Dieselpreise vor den US-Zwischenwahlen am 3. November zu senken. Dazu gehört auch die Aussetzung von Teilen eines neuen Sanktionsgesetzes gegen Russland. Der unter maltesischer Flagge fahrende Tanker "Agioi Fanendes" wurde den Schifffahrtsdaten zufolge am 22. Oktober im russischen Ostseehafen Primorsk mit schwefelarmem Diesel beladen. Er soll am 7. November in den USA eintreffen. Wer Käufer und Verkäufer der Ladung sind, war zunächst nicht bekannt. Ein Kreml-Sprecher bestätigte am Freitag, dass ein erstes Schiff im Rahmen der Vereinbarung ausgelaufen sei. Er ließ jedoch offen, ob es für den US-Markt oder einen anderen bestimmt ist. "Soweit ich weiß, gab es bereits Berichte aus dem Energieministerium, dass der erste Tanker tatsächlich zu seinen Empfängern, seinen Käufern, ausgelaufen ist", sagte Dmitri Peskow. "Weitere Lieferungen werden von nun an in gleichmäßigem Tempo fortgesetzt." Russland hatte zugestimmt, ein selbst auferlegtes Exportverbot für Diesel aufzuheben, um den Kraftstoff wieder auf die Weltmärkte zu liefern. Trump hatte am 9. Oktober angekündigt, dass Russland zunächst 300.000 Tonnen oder 2,25 Millionen Barrel exportieren werde. Darauf sollen 500.000 Tonnen im November und eine Million Tonnen "unmittelbar danach" folgen. Der stellvertretende russische Ministerpräsident Alexander Nowak erklärte vergangene Woche, Russland könne seine Dieselausfuhren bis zum Jahresende auf das übliche Volumen von drei bis 3,5 Millionen Tonnen pro Monat steigern. Seit dem Inkrafttreten des vollständigen EU-Embargos gegen russische Ölprodukte im Februar 2023 wegen des Krieges in der Ukraine hat Russland Diesel hauptsächlich nach Brasilien, in die Türkei sowie in afrikanische Länder exportiert. Auch nach der Aufhebung des jüngsten, selbst auferlegten Exportverbots wegen Knappheiten infolge ukrainischer Angriffe wurden den Schifffahrtsdaten zufolge wieder Ladungen für die traditionellen Bestimmungsorte wie die Türkei und Brasilien verladen. Bei anderen Tankern, die in Primorsk beladen wurden, war das Ziel zunächst unklar.

item.title: 中国財政収入、1─9月5.1％増に鈍化 土地売却収入27.9％減
item.description: ［北京 ２３日 ロイター］ - 中国財政省が２３日発表した１─９月の財政収入は前年比５．１％増加の１７兆２０００億元...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国財政収入、1─9月5.1％増に鈍化　土地売却収入27.9％減 17:46 配信

2025年7月18日、上海のビル群。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura/File Photo

［北京　２３日　ロイター］ - 中国財政省が２３日発表した１─９月の財政収入は前年比５．１％増加の１７兆２０００億元（２兆５８００億ドル）で、伸び率は１─８月の５．７％から鈍化した。

財政収入は、税収が６．１％増、税外収入が１．２％増だった。

１─９月の財政支出は１．０％増で、１─８月の１．２％増から鈍化した。

財政省当局者は会見で、今年、地方政府特別債の発行を加速させており、２７年の発行枠の一部を前倒しで割り当てる計画だと述べた。

同当局者によると、１─９月の特別債の純発行額は３兆５６００億元で、年間発行枠の８１％に達した。９月の発行額は６３３５億元で、前年同月を２１４８億元上回った。

１─９月の政府の土地売却収入は前年比２７．９％減少。１─８月の２８．６％減から減少幅が縮小した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：中国政府、株市場てこ入れ作戦に公的年金基金も動員 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：経済モデル転換目指す中国、不動産不況でも資源需要衰えず コラム：「カメ」の米国株が「ウサギ」の中国を追い抜く時 最終更新: 10/23(金) 17:50 ロイター

While the BOJ said in its semi-annual report it did not see any major financial imbalances, it said risi

Bank of Japan warns of risks from AI market shock, cyberattacks

TOKYO, Oct 23 : The Bank of Japan warned on Friday of rising risks caused by AI, including growing cybersecurity threats and potential market shocks, that could spill over to the country's banking system.  While the BOJ said in its semi-annual report it did not see any major financial imbalances, it said rising property and stock prices warranted careful attention given still-low interest rates. Japan's financial system may have become more susceptible to global market fluctuations as domestic banks have steadily increased lending to foreign non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs), which are big hyperscaler funders, the BOJ said in the report on Japan's banking system. "If expectations regarding the profitability of AI-related investment were to decline, shocks could be amplified, mainly through portfolio adjustments in the foreign NBFI sector, and the effects could spill over to Japan," it said.

NBFIs are involved in what is commonly referred to as the "shadow banking" sector that includes private credit providers and private equity funds. If hyperscalers do not meet lofty market expectations, the resulting global market correction could hit Japanese stock prices that have risen on hopes of strong profits in AI-related sectors, the BOJ report said. "Given that Japanese banks have a certain amount of market risk associated with their stockholdings, close attention should continue to be paid to developments in risky asset prices, including stock prices," the report said. OVERHEATING CONCERNS  Property price growth has accelerated in Japan's three major metropolitan areas with surging construction costs and labour shortages adding to upward pressure from strong demand, including from foreign investors, the report said. The BOJ raised interest rates to a 31-year high of 1.25 per cent last month and signalled its readiness to keep increasing borrowing costs to prevent inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target. It has also stressed the need to scrutinise banks' lending behaviour and financial conditions in determining the timing and pace of future rate hikes. As cyberattacks using AI triggered shutdowns of websites across the globe, the BOJ also urged financial institutions to better prepare for threats including the misuse of generative AI. "Cyber incidents not only pose a risk to individual financial institutions and their customers but are also a material risk from a macroprudential perspective, given their impact can potentially spread to other financial institutions," the report said.

Source: Reuters
